tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum dang 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab kha skong pod gnyis pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /rdo rje gur gyi rgyud rje btsun gyi mchan dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ḍā ki ni badz+ra pañjar ma hā tan+t+ra rā dza kalpa nā ma | bod skad du/ 'phags pa sa gsungs pa/ gzugs kyi sku ni rdzu 'phrul gyis mkha' 'gro/ chos kyi sku ni nam mkha' ltar cir yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis 'gro/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje tshogs sam 'du ba/ gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi don ston pa/ rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa/ ste gtan la dbab pa// ༈ kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di la sho lo ka stong nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhugs so/ /spyir rgyud gsum bzhugs pa las/ thams cad las dang bdag med pa yan chad gtso bor rgyu rgyud la sbyar nam skye gnas kyi nam mkha'/ mkha' he ru ka skye gnas kyi gzhi bems gang ltar yang 'byung ba bzhi ste snod la gcig bcud la mngal gyi sngon 'gro dang mngal gnas gnyis/ bskyed rim la brten pas/ lugs ldog lugs 'byung gnyis/ lha la rigs lnga yab yum gnyis/ sngags la 'khor lo bzhi/ chos la reg pa sra ba sogs lnga ste dgur bshad do bcas sa/ dwangs chu/ pa dang*/ / puk+ka sī sogs/ go me/ skabs med dang yan lag gi rlung yul la/ 'byed pa dang*/ / ༈ dngos po sna tshogs bzhir bshad de/ sbyang gzhi dang*/ rdo bskyed pa lha rdzogs pa gnyis 'byung ba lnga'o// rje'i ye shes kyi tshogs stong pa/ gzhi gnas snod/ khang*/ / 1chu/2de'i steng du 'byung ba rim rtsegs las gzhal yas khang*/bcud la zer te sbyang gzhi'o/ / sems can khams me/ dang ( 2 ) rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ( 1 ) yid 'ong dang*/ / sbyang gzhi sems 'jig rten/ can snod dang 'jig rten mdor/ dang*/ /sa rgyas/ dang snod/ sa 'og bar sa bla/ snang dang*/ / bcud bstan yid zhabs 'og dang lus dang mkha' spyod/ ngag dang ni/ / sa spyod/gnyis med ye shes gcig la gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba/ gnyis dang mkha' dngos po dang dngos med kyi bde ba/

bde dang | | rigs drug dang lha mo'am phung po lnga dang rigs/ drug gnyis dang*/ /bzhi gzugs/ 'dod pa/ gzugs med/ 'dus ma byas zag med kyi ye shes dang bzhi/ dang skye 'gro rnams dang ni || gcig mtshan gzhi/ gis khams bco brgyad do// nyi shur ma tshang mtshan nyid stong pa nyid de bcu dgu/ dang*/ khams stong pa dag par bya ba bsdus nas ston/ gsum ma lus pa dang ni/ /pha 'dod khams/ dang bu dang ma ma dang*/ /phyi gzugs khams te 'dod pa'i longs spyod spangs te| rol dang ni nang gi sems ni gzugs med pa'i khams te sems tsam/ dang ngam/ /btsun mo 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha mo/ kun dang 'dod khams/ chos rjes su 'brang ma/ dang ni/ / gzugs khams/ thams khams gsum gyi las so so/ cad bde ba chen po bskyed pa dang mchod pa la sogs pa/ las dang lta ba dang ye shes ba dag med dang*/ / gzugs med/ tshig rkang gnyis po 'dis rgyud gsum spyi'am yang na gong ma nyan thos gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas la sbyar ro/ /mthar ni zhi ba'i bde rig dang*/ yan chad rigs gtso bor thabs rgyud la sbyar ro/ / 'bras rgyud du zhugs pa la sogs pa/ bu rgyu ni gang zag gi bdag med pa la mos pa la sogs pa/ dang bya ba ni byed pa gang zag go/ zhes/ / bsgrub bya 'bras bu rang sangs rgyas rigs gnyis/ sgrub lam rten 'brel/ thabs rdo rgyu 'bras dbyer mi phyed pas gang zag rje dang*/ / rgyu 'bras ltar/ de bzhin sems tsam pas khas blangs pa'i lam 'bras| kun gzhi rnam par shes/ / pa de gnas gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ chos mnyam nyid| kyi dbyings bdag tu nga rgyal/ bdag tu rtog pa/ bdag tu 'dzin pa ste nyon mongs pa can gyi yid ni rgyu/ dang gnas gyur bya ba nan tan dngos su/ ma byung so sor skye ba spangs pa/ dang*/ /nam so sor rtog pa dngos su/ mkha'i khams ni sems te sems nam mkha' lta bu nyid sna tshogs su snang ba'o// dang ltar spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes/

rang dbyings nyid sna tshogs su snang ba/ dang*/ /bdag gnyis| med pa dbu ma pas khas blangs pa la yang bzhugs pa bstan/ dang kun brtags/ bdag ces dang | | dngos don dam par/ po med dang kun rdzob tu/ dngos med min/ / sngags pas khas blangs pa'i rgyu 'bras la yang bzhugs par bstan/ 'di la gsum bshad do// bde bskyed pa ltar na rten chos 'byung sngags ltar na lte ba chos ltar na mkha' gzhi chos 'byung gi dbyibs/ ba can mkha' dbyings dga' ba/ dang gru gsum lte ba'i dbyibs dang*/ / 'di man chad gtum mo'i ye shes la sbyar a ste skye ba med pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i skyon med rtog pa'i rdul med/ rtog pa'i rlabs med pas zhi ba'o bde ba'o|| a ā sogs las zla ba kā sogs las nyi ma 'bras bu sangs rgyas rigs gnyis/ skyes dang ni skyon mun med skyon bral mchog dga'/ bral dang*/ / dga' bral/ rdul gnyis kyi bar na rdo rje/ bral dang ni des sems can gyi/ sdig bcom spros bsdus badz+ra at+ma ko ( ྅ ) haṃ zhes bya ba nan tan/ dang*/ / rba kun tu bzang po'i rnam pa la lha gnas par brjod pa/ rlabs lhan skyes kyi yon tan ni rtog pa'i rba rlabs med pa/ mdang*/ /rba med pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ / de thams cad 'dres pa las gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings so// mthar yan lag drug rdzogs pa'i mthar bskyed ba snang la rang bzhin med pa/ ni lhan skyes rtog pa thams cad zhi ba/ zhi rtog pa/ ba'i chen po/ bde rig dang*/ / spros bral bsgom pa/gtso bor 'bras bu la/ gsang ba rnam snang me long ye shes/mi bskyod/ mchog chos dbyings ye shes/ dang snang mtha'/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ dgyes rin 'byung*/ pa mnyam nyid ye shes| la/ / ༈ ( ga ) rta mchog gi 'khrugs can 'grel bshad/ 'khrugs med rgyud rkyang gi sangs rgyas kun khyab rnam snang*/ sems bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ dpa' ni/ /mkha' ston pa longs sku| 'gro ma yi ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/

rdo rje gur/ / bzhugs pa po rdo rje 'dzin/ 'di chos sku| ni rang byung phyi rol gyi byed pa po lta bu'i rgyu las sam/ yang na rgyu rkyen la ma ltos par dang po nas byung bas bcom ldan 'das/ /lha yi rnam snang yin pas de rnams kyi rten yin pas bdag po'o// bdag po gcig pu nyid/ / 'di gnyis sprul sku ( kha ) thams cad brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid do// bdag nyid rtag tu dus/ bzhugs/ / sam gyi drug pa las/ gsang ba la ni sa yi khams/ /mchog la de bzhin du ni chu/ /dgyes pa la ni me ru bshad/ /thams cad bdag nyid rlung du gnas| |rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa bdag /yang ni me long lta bu'i tshul| |shin tu rnam dag rang bzhin can/ /so sor rtog pa cho ga bzhin/ /de bzhin du yang mnyam pa nyid// de bzhin bya ba nan tan la/ /rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa'o/ /de bzhin rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /mi bskyod pa yi ngo bo dang*/ /yang na 'od dpag med pa yis/ /yang na rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /gang tshe rtag bzhugs don yod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sngon byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor las de yan chad kyis chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum ka'i gnas rgyas par bstan/ston pa cung zad tsam bstan nas 'khor bstan pa ni|rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga'i 'khor de bzhin gshegs pas bsdus pa bstan/ bdag nyid/ kye rdo rje | | las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa 'di lta'o// las ni dkyil 'khor lnga gsungs pa | | rdo 'di rnams rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor ro// rje can dang phan pa dang*/ /de bzhin rdo rje gzi brjid nyid/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rta bdun rgyal po lnga pa'o/ / rdo rje so so'i 'khor gyi lha mo/ mkha' 'gro'i dkyil gzhal yas khang*/ 'khor du/ /dkar mu rkun ma ro langs ma/ /ghasma rī dang puk+ka sī/ /ri khrod gdol pa g.yung mo'o/ /rdo rje phan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/

/skam pa zhags pa ma nyid dang*/ /dol ma dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /me tog bdug pa/ ma sogs mar me ma/ mtshams dri chab ma/ kyi char/ / rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nyi lag ma dang mar me ma/ /rin chen sgrol ma glog lag ma/ /lā s+ye mā le/ la sogs gīrti/ mtshams nirti/ char ro/ /pad+ma chos 'byung lcags sgrog dang*/ /'khyud gtso bo la 'khyud pa'i tshul/ ma gar gyi dkyil 'khor du/ / gling bu la pi wang ma rdza rnga ma mu kun dha/ sogs mtshams gyi char/ /bdag nyid cha byad sbyor bas so/ /rta yi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje sgo lcags lde kyog ma/ / sgo ma dang ni gos 'dzin ma/ /de bzhin mtshams su spyan ma mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma/ sogs/ rdo mi phyed/ rje mkha' 'gro de rnams kun/ /rkang pa bzhugs thabs/ g.yon pa brkyang pas gnas/ / phyag rgya/ snying khar g.yon brkyangs sdig g.yas pa rnams na rang rang gi mtshan ma/ mdzub ste/ kha dog sna tshogs 'od/ cher 'bar ba'o/ /shin tu zhe sdang zhe sdang che/ /gau rī la sogs rab tu grags/ /shin lha mo rnams kyi las/ tu gti mug rmongs chen las/ / grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ skam pa ma skam pa mas gdul bya la bde ba mi rtog pa bskyed pa ni/ sogs ches bzung ngo*/ /shin tu nyi ma la sogs pas gdul bya la bde ba chen po'i rang rig pa'i ye shes/ gzi brjid cher gsal ba/ /nyi ma la sogs rab tu grags | | shin tu so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'dod chags chags bde ba chen po la tha mal pa grol bar byed/ chen pas/ /pad sogs chos kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /phrag dog chen po'i bya ba nan tan gyis tha mal ba'i phrag dog las/ sgrib chen las/ /sgo lcags kyis nang du 'gro mi ster te phrag dog byed pa bzhin ma sogs kyis theg pa gzhan du 'jug mi ster/ myur 'gro bdag/rgyal ba mgon po gsung gis don mdzad pa'i phrin las/ phan pa ni/ /gti rgyu 'bras med par rmongs pa/ mug thams cad zad par mdzad/

/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bstan pas/ rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/ /rnam gdul bya'i nga rgyal gyi/ par rtog pas bdag tu lta ba'i rab rib 'phrog/rta rtog pa las dbugs 'byin/ mgrin 'dod pa chen po ni/ /'dod bde ba la chags pa/ chags can gyi sems can la bsten pa'i sgo nas/ byang chub ster/ /rdo rje mgyogs 'gro phrag dog byed pa/ che/ /theg de'i sgo nas/ pa gzhan nyan thos la sogs pa/ ni rnam par spangs | | rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ / rtog pa mi bskyod ye chos kyi dbyings kyi/ shes 'byung ba'i gnas/ /skye gdul bya/ 'gro bsten cing rim gro byas pas mgron ni mi dmigs pa'i shes rab/ mi bzad mgron gnyer phyir/ / gti mug la sogs pa/ sgrib pa lnga pos gdul bya'i rgyud ni/ ni 'joms pa don dang sems can du snang ba dang bdag tu gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dang 'du byed dang 'jug pa'i rnam shes te ye shes lnga las/ po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa byed pas mi phyed pa/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / gdul bya/ zhe sdang gti mug skus don mdzad pa'i phrin las/ nga rgyal dang*/ / phrag dog 'dod chags ser sna skye bo rnams | | mi spang zhing 'khor du/ bsdu phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ rang gi 'khor lo la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de/ gzugs ni du ma 'dzin/ / mdor shin rgyas/ tu gdug pa zhe sdang dang ldan pa la/ drag po la/ /zhi gdul thabs/ ba nye bar mi sbyar te/ / zhi bas mi 'dul ba/ 'di mkhyen nas/ rdo rje can chen ni/ /rang gis mi bskyod pa/ kye yi rdo rjer gyur/ / sprul/ shin tu skur 'debs/ stong par zhen rnams kyi/ /yod las rgyu 'bras/ min de sdig pa sna tshogs byed pa/ brtul zhugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ / don du/ sangs rgyas gti mug rnam snang*/ spyod don du/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam snang du gyur/ gyur/ /shin tu nga rgyal gdug rnams kyis/

/skye 'gro'i nga rgyal zad par mdzad/ / pa'i phyir/ rdo rje nyi ma bdag nyid kyi/ rgyal/ / bar bstan pa/ tha mal pa'i/ nga rgyal chen po'i mun de ni shin tu gzi brjid che bar bstan/ pa 'joms/ /byang bsten pa lam du byed pa rnams/ chub chags pa dang bral ba/ las skyes spangs/ / te bsten pas thob/ sems can gang zhig bsten pas rgyud/ bde byed pa/ /chags pas byang chub rab grub phyir/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ces bya ba shin tu chags pa chen por/ gyur/ / sprul/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gnas yod bzhin du| shing*/ /gang zhig lam thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ma yin pa nyan thos sogs kyi/ gzhan nas 'gro ba/ /de rnams lam log par 'gro ba la phrag dog byas pas/ byang chub rab sbyin phyir | | rdo rje mgyogs 'gro rang gtso bo/ / ste rdo rje 'dzin gyis bstan/ dbang po skus don mdzad pa bsdus nas bstan/ gang dang gang lam du byed pa/ nyid*/ /de gang la gang gis 'dul pa de la der ston pa/ dang de nyid ngo bor 'gro/ /mchog sangs rgyas kyi mngon shes/ tu phan pa'i rang bzhin lhun grub tu 'jug pa/ rnal 'byor gyis/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid/ sangs rgyas rnam snang sogs| kun gyi bdag nyid 'gyur/ / bstan/ gang rigs/ dang gang gi dngos po yis// gdul bya/ skyes pa rnams kyi yid 'dun par byed/ sbyor ba/ /des na de ji ltar mos pa bzhin ston pas/ yi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /sna tshogs gzugs su nor bu rin po cher ston pa/ nor ji bzhin no/ / bsgyur du btub pas/ gang dang gang gsung gi sgo nas mdzad pa bsdus par bstan/ gis 'dul ba yis/ /sems can de rnams la de dang de bstan pas/ 'dul bar 'gyur pa ste/ /de dang de yi gang la cis 'dul de la mthun pa'i/ rnam pa yis/ /chos kyi bshad par bya ba'o/ /sems sems sbyong ba'i tshul gyis don mdzad pa ste glo bur gyis sbyong ba'o// kyi ji ltar don mdzad pa/ rdo rje rang*/ las byung ba'i/

/ de nyid ma rtogs na/ sems de dngos su rang byung gi can sna tshogs rang bzhin can/ /sems ni ye shes yin pa la glo bur gyi/ bdag gi rnam rtog gis/ /skye bo dri mas nag por byas/ / te bsgribs/ de bas kun tu rab 'bad pas | | sems kyi rdo rje rang byung de'i glo bur gyi dri ma/ rnam par sbyang*/ /sems glo bur gyi sgrib pa las/ dag pa ni bde ba yin/ /nyon glo bur gyi/ mongs dug ni thams cad 'phrog | gal te stong pa nyid tsam po rang sangs rgyas pa'i/ thabs lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa ni grol ba'i rgyur rang mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ yin no zhe/ na/ / lan du /de 'i/ tshe sangs rgyas gzugs sku/ nyid du/ mi 'gyur/ /

ro snyam na/ gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pas rgyu 'bras mthun dgos pas/ 'bras bu rgyu las gzhan min phyir/ /thabs gzugs sku 'grub pa'i/ ni stong pa nyid ma 'ba' zhig yin/ /lta ba rnams las log te yang dag pa'i lta ba dang bral ba/ rnams dang*/ /bdag tu lta ba tshol rnams kyis/ /bdag zhen bsam pa bdag la mchog tu 'dzin pa dang*/ gang zag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ chos kyi rang bzhin du 'dzin pa dang*/ chos tsam du 'dzin pa rnams/ bzlog pa'i phyir/ /stong bskyed rim la chos su 'dzin pas stong pa rdzogs rim la lha'i dri mas stong ste/ pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ / 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i thabs gzugs kyi sku 'grub par bya ba'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'ba' zhig bsgom pa ma yin gyi bskyed rim yang bsgom par bstan/ de bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis 'grub pa/ phyir 'o na phar phyin yang shes rab kyis zin pa'i phar phyin la sogs pa la yod pas de lta bu 'grub bam 'on te tshul gzhan zhig ce na/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs gzugs sku 'grub pa'i/ ni bde ba'i 'dod pa la brten pas/ sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal bskyed rim gyi/ rnal 'byor gyis/ / sangs rgyas gzugs kyi sku/ nyid du myur bar 'gyur/ / 'o na sangs rgyas rang rnam pa med pa zhig gam snyam na ma yin te/ ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'i/ phyir thabs kyis bsgrub bya dang*/ /de dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ ni thabs kyi gzugs can no/ /thams de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po/ cad ky-i stong pa/ rnam pa mchog tha mal pa'i rtog pa/ tu zhi rgya che ba/ ba'i sems de'i sgo nas/ can rigs lnga'i dngos grub/ 'jug pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// // le'u dang po la sho lo ka sum cu so bdun dang rkang pa gnyis so/ /le'u dang pos yi dam gyi lha spyan drangs pa bstan/ le'u gnyis pa'i bstod kyis de la mchod pa bstan/

de nas rdo rje 'dzin/ khams gsum las khyad par can/ thob/ / bdag por/de nyid/ rnal 'byor ma nyid/ yi ste shes rab/ rdo rje gur/ / gyis/ dam 'da' bar mi bya ba/ tshig mchod pa'i yid 'ong ba/ /'khor la rab tu bka' stsal pa/ /glu sgra yin la de ni mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo yin pas/ ni rdo rje can la 'bul | | gar ni lus kyi bdag nyid yin la rnam snang yang sku dag pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /hi rin po che la bya/ ra mchog 'ad ོ da pa'i don sgrub pas/ la de bzhin dri rnam par dag pa yin pas/ dri/ /'jig rten rje la ro dag pa yin pas/ bza' dang btung*/ / ba'i ro 'bul/ gos kyi chod pa reg bya yin la/ pa rta mchog kyang reg bya dag pa yin pas/ la/ / 'di rnams mchod par bya ba las mi 'da' bas/ dam tshig dam pa ste/ / dbul rdzas dang dbul ba'i yul mi phyed pa/ rdo rje mchod pa byas pa yis/ /rdo rje can kun de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po/ mnyes par byed/ /a kha dog mthun pas/ ka spyir btang du rin chen 'byung ldan la dbul yang*/ bye brag tu kha dog gi sgo nas rigs lnga car la dbul/ ru nag kye rdo rje/ /phan pa la ni tsan+dan dkar | | po'i dri/tsan+dan/ dmar po 'jig rten rje la dbul/ kha gur gum/ che rdo rje snang ser por mthun/ pa la/ /bdun gyi rgyal po'i dang 'dra ba ste phrin las byed par 'dra bas/ thams las thams cad pa yin pas/ cad de/ / tha mal pa'i dri mi dmigs pa las/ hūm̐ gi rdo rje las byung ba'i dri/ / yang na gnyis med ye shes snang ba/ 'di rnams dri yi mchod pa/ rab sbyor bas | | dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid 'thob bo/ kha spyir btang du 'jig rten rje la dbul yang bye brag rigs lnga car la dbul/ ba dri chu/ tsha ba phyi rol la yang sbyar/ rdo rjer dbul/ /mngar dri chen| ba rdo rje rtag pa 'i ngo bo yin pas/ la/ /skyur ba rak+ta/ rdo rje nyi ma 'i ngo bo yin pas/ la// de bzhin lan ga pur/ tshwa 'jig rten rjer/

/ 'i ngo bo yin pas/ rta yi rgyal po'i la ro/ thams cad dam/ /ska yang na/ ba rab sha chen/ tu brtag par bya/ / spyir btang gzugs rnam snang yin yang mdog kye yi rdo rje rdor can gyis/ /me tog mdog nag rkang 'thung las shing gi rtsa bas chu 'thung bas shing gi ming ngo*//glang po la gnyis 'thung zer ba bzhin no// 'byung*/ / ba'o| | ma me tog dkar po/ l+li ka dang mā la dkar po/ ti/ /kun da rtag tu sangs rgyas dbul | | shing gi dbang ut+pal/ mchog dri med ser po/ mdog /snang byed la ni sbyar bar bya/ /dbang mchog ut+pal/ dmar po chu skyes pad+ma/ dang*/ /ban dhu dmar po ba ṭa dmar po/ laṃ/ /pad+ma me tog dang kha dog gi sgo nas lnga char la dbul/ gar gyi dbang la dbul | | rta mchog rdo rje can la dbul/ /rdo rje can gyi khru de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor kyi tshad rdo rje can gyi shu tra ste de zhu ba ste bde ba mi rtog pa gsum dang ldan pas sam/ yang na de'i rten bha ga gru gsum yin pas/ gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor khru ni lus dag pa yin pas lus chu zheng 'dom re re mnyam pas/ bzhi pa/ /snang byed la ni khru bdud rtsi lnga mtshon pas/ lnga nyid/ / pad+ma gar dbang dkar po/ ut+pal/ ser po/ ut+pal/ pad+ma/ dmar po/ me tog dang kha dog gi sgo nas lnga char la dbul/ de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor kyi tshad rdo rje can gyi shu tra ste de zhu ba ste bde ba mi rtog pa gsum dang ldan pas sam/ yang na de'i rten bha ga gru gsum yin pas ni lus dag pa yin pas lus chu zheng 'dom re re mnyam pas bdud rtsi lnga mtshon pas bdud rtsi lnga de'i bde ba dang drug drug pa ste/ / lcags kyi rgyal po de bzhin bdud rtsi lnga po des dga' bral dang lhan skyes mtshon/ bdun/ / bza' ba las kyang 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa/ bza' la rdo rje nyi ma yi sa kyang sgrub/ lam 'gro ba la/ du 'gro ba yang las su bya ba yin la 'di yang las thams cad kyi ngo bo yin pas/

lcags kyi mchog gi rnal 'byor gyis/ dang*/ /gnyid ni gti mug yin pas/ la sangs rgyas mgon po la gti mug dag pa/ yi/ / rjes su chags pa la/ shin tu bde ba gar yang rjes su chags pa/ dbang gi /glu g.yo| gar de bzhin rol mo'i sgra/ /sa gzhi yongs gzung dus su ni/ /rdo bar chad bsrung ba la khro bo'i cha lugs shes pas/ rje'i gzugs su bzhag nas mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bya/ ni/ / mi bskyod pa/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rab tu bsgrub/ /rdo tshon gyi kha dog bstan pa ste dkyil 'khor gyi pho brang*/ rje'i dbang po sngon po ste/ /zla dkar por bya/ ba chu shel thub chen rnam snang*/ gyi/ /mkhar rin 'byung gi phyin nor bu dmar rgyal mkha' mdzod kyi/ skyes pa'i me tog dmar/ / ser por 'ong*/ pad+ma rā ga dmar po spyan ras 'od dpag med/ gzigs/ / rta'i 'ang ma ra ka sna tshogs te ljang khu/ ta ste/ /rin rgyal pos/ chen lnga yi rdul tshon mchog/de 'di dag gis bsrung ba'i 'khor lo shugs kyis bstan/ nas bcom thabs rgyud mtha' dag sgrub pa/ ldan 'das rdo rje chen po mkha' 'gro ma'i da ni las phran tshegs gsung*/ rdo rje'i gur 'byung po bgegs/ 'dul ba'i he ru ka phyag bzhi pa/ ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ / bza' bsrung gi bgegs bsrung ba las mi 'da' bas dam tshig yang dag rab phye ba/ / sngon 'gro kha bskang rdo rje bzhi las bskyed/ kun tu bzang po'i sa hūm̐ bon bdag /dbang de las/ po sngon in+d+ra nī la/ po lta bu'i 'od/ / zer lnga/ phyag bzhi 'jigs byed chen po ste/ /mdzes sgeg khro| pa'i khro bo yi ni lus/ /dbang ldan 'byung po mnan pa ste/ /g.yas par rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje/ 'dzin/ /lag pa phyag g.yon sdigs par mdzad pa ste/ g.yon pas khyi lpags nyid/ / phyag gnyis po dag gis hūm̐ mdzad kyi/ phyag rgyar yum la 'khyud/ sbyor/ / zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas yang dag gnas/ /cung zad mche bas gtsigs pas/

'jigs par byed/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba'i rgyan mchog ste/ /mgo byang sems/ 'dzings dbu skra 'dzings shing zla phyed brgyan dang zer/ phyed du bcing bar ni/ / ri rab/ ri yi gnas gang du bsgom na/ rtse mor bsgom par bya/ / de ltar bsgoms nas gang 'grub na/ 'byung po 'dul ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin du ma 'byung po dang*/ /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang || mi mo lha yi mdzes ma ni/ /sgrub pa po yis nges dbang du 'gyur ba/ par 'grub// sngags ni/ /oṃ bhū ta ḍā 'byung po 'dul ba/ ma ra bhū ta a dhi pa ti bdag po/ a k+ṣo bh+ya ki rī btumaX pa'am rim par/ ṭī na sarba bhū 'byung po thams cad/ ta pre yi dwags/ ta pi shā tsā sha za/ na sā dha sgrubs shig ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de 'di yi cho ga bzhi las bskyed/ nas rdo rje chen po mi phyed/ rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur bsam gtan dang bzlas pa tsam gyis/ stobs po tshogs kyi bdag po/ che'i ting nge 'dzin 'khor med/ la bzhugs so/ / des ci byed na/ char char mi 'bab na| chen rab tu dbab bya ste/ / paṃ las pad+ma klu'i mgo ltar/ 'dab ma brgyad pa dngos su bri ba'am| bsam/ /der ni klu brgyad dgod par bya/ / der bya khyung*/shar du mtha' yas nag po/ lhor nor rgyas dkar po/ nub tu 'ablog po dmar po/ byang du stobs kyi rgyu blon po/ me dang bden bral du pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po gnyis ser skya/ rlung du dur skyong ser po/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan sna tshogs/ stobs lte ba la/ po cher ni rab sbyar bas/ /de rnams rnga bya khyung gis te stobs po che/ ma yang dag mnan/ /char med na/ stobs po che las ni/ /chu yi tshogs ni dbab par bya | kha dog gnag cing 'od/ cher gsal ba/ /'jig klu/ pa yang ni bya khyung gis/ 'jigs par mdzad/ /phyag brgyad zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /mkha' stobs po che/ lding rdo sbrul brgyad kyis/ rje'i gdan mdzad pa/ /phyag rnams kyis ni klu bdag

brgyad/ bsnams | | phuḥzhes bya ba'i sngags zlos shing*/ /hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ dag nang du gnyis kyi ni bar du bcug ste/ chud byas te/ /phaṭa ni mtha' tu sbyar bar bya/ /dang po'i zhal rtsa ba/ ni nag po ste/ /gnyis pa g.yas/ zla 'od bzang po nyid/ /gsum pa g.yon/ ser po'i mdog lta bu/ /bzhi rgyab/ pa dmar po nyid du brjod/ /sbrul brgyad/ kyi rgyan gyis yan lag brgyad/ /rdo rje dbu rgyan du/ sems dpas mi bskyod pa/ rnam par brgyan// klu rnams gdul ba/ kyis ni char dbab phyir/ /stobs po che ni rab bsgrub bya/ / sngar bstan pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rnam pa de dang de dag gi rnam par snang yang ngo bo gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen por mos par bya ba'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin rdo rje drug pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'phrul byed yin pas/ 'dzin pa rdo rje gur smra ba pos sangs rgyas kyi lnga thob par byed pa lam gyi sam bshad par/ de kho na dbye bar bya'o/ / rdo rje pad rnam par smin pa dang rnam par nyed pa'i skad gcig ma las/ ma rnam pa sna tshogs don gyis shes par bya/ 'o byas dang*/ /ri dwags ni zla ba des byang sems mtshon/ brgyan mtshan nyid dang bral ba la/ pa zos shu tra kha snar mngon du byas pa/ pa dang*/ /rdo rje khu ba/ chu 'thung phyir ma shor ba/ nor ldan bde ba pas/ / mi rtog pa/ sangs rgyas de kho na/ nyid thob pa'i lam gyi don gyi ye shes/ 'di rig nga*/ / byang sems/ dag pa'i de 'ba' zhig tu ma zad tsaṇ+ḍa lī yang bsgom par bstan/ gnas bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ ni gnas longs spyod gyi 'khor lo/ chen po/ / bruṃ sogs lnga maṃ sogs bzhi| sangs chos kyi 'khor lo/ rgyas kun tshangs pa'i bu ga nas de nang gi sgrub pa/

gyis rab gang ba | | rdo mi rtog pa/ rje rin byang sems/ chen kun sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ khyab par/ /gang rang byung ye shes mngon du byed par/ gyur pa de/ nga yis bshad par mdor/ bya/ / sprul pa/ rgyas/ phan 'khor lo gang du mngon du bya zhe na/ pa'i grong sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lor/ khyer rnal 'byor pa'i lus la/ yid 'ong pa'i gnas yin pas/ bar/ / phyi rol gau rī lcags kyu thogs pas bkug pa de phyi'i bsnyen pa rgyun mi 'chad par sbyor ba dang nang gi bsnyen pa mkha' thabs gang gis bya zhe na/ 'gro oṃ 'bar bas/ rdo rje rgyun mi 'chad par sbyor ba nang gi bsnyen pa'o// lu gu rgyud/ /zhen phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs khar bzhugs pa'i me'o// pa chen pos nye bar sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas kun/ / phyi rol du tsau rī zhags pa thogs pas bdag gi lus la gzhug pa ste nye bar bsgrub pa/gtum mo/ lcags sgrog rdo rjes bcing phyi rol du be tā lī lcags sgrog thogs pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par 'ching ba'i phyir bsgrub pa'o// par bya/ / nang gi bsgrub pa'o// dga' bde chen/ ldan du ni ldeg par phyi rol du ghasma rī dril bu thogs pas sangs rgyas te ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'gul ba thob te mnyes shing dbang du byed pa bsgrub pa chen po/ 'gyur/ /sangs bdud rtsi/ rgyas rnams sprul par phab pa/ kyi 'dod pa 'thob/ / mi rtog pa mngon du byas so//de ltar byas pa'i phan yon/ rgyal ba mgon po yang mkhar dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ byams pa ni/ /ye lcags kyu la sogs pa'i stobs kyis sgrub pa/ shes spyan gyis rnam par gzigs/ / 1su gzhug go zhes 'og ma'i 'go drang du yang rung ngo*//2te sgrub pa po de byin gyis brlab cing dngos grub ster/3so zhes/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings pas | | lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dgug pa/ rgyal zhags pa'i phyag rgyas gzhug pa/ ba'i tshogs rnams bcing bar bya/

/gang dus gang gi tshe na/ zhig dngos grub mi ster na/ /sgrog 'od zer gyis/ gis bcings nas snying khar gnod mdzes su bsgrub pa/ dgug par bya/ / lha gang dang gang gis bya ba bstan/ rdo rjes kyo ba lcags kyu/ dkar mo che/ / gau rī/ rdo rje zhags pa thogs pa| chom rkun ma/ / yis gzhug rdo rje lcags sgrog thogs pa/ ro langs ma/ / yis bcing*/ rdo rje dril bu thogs pa/ ghasma rī/ / yis mnyes shing dbang du byas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sgrub pa po| dbang du byed/ /bzlas dang bsgom la bskyed pa la thun bzhir/ mngon dga' ba'i/ / dngos grub gal te spyan ras kyis mi 'tsho/ mi ster na/ /de tshe gau rī la sogs pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yis/ / bsgrubs pa'i gnod mdzes kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni drag shul sgrub

| | phur bus gdab pa le'u dgu par bstan/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po chos sku nam mkha' ltar stong pa'i ngang las/ mkha' 'gro gzugs sku rdzu 'phrul gyis/ ma'i rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi rgyas pa'i/ nang du 'bum gleng gzhi/ phrag lnga yod ces/ bris pa yang dag par te rgyas par gsal bar/ bshad par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni dkyil 'khor kyi rgyud 'bum/ /rdo rje can gyi rgyud/ de bzhin 'bum/ /'bum gyis rdo rje nyi ma yi/ /'bum gyis rdo rje chos kyi'o/ /'bum phrag phyed kyis rdo rje rta/ /'byung po 'dul ba 'i rgyud stong phrag lngas | | ston/ stong phrag lnga yis las ni rab zhi ba la sogs pa/ rgyas ston/ pa/ /lnga stong phrag yis sangs rgyas kyi/ gar mkhan nyid/ / de dag ji ltar bya ba bstan pa'i lnga/ stong phrag sum cu dag gis ni/ /ku ru kul+le brtag pa'o/ /lhag ma stong phrag lnga yis ni/ / cho dbang sogs/ ga'i rim pa rgyud kun gyi'o/ / cho ga'i rim pa stong phrag lngas/ rdo rgyud sde/ rje mkha' 'gro kye'i rdo rje'i/ /'bum phrag lnga 'i grangs/ ni bris pa'o/ / 'di bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan par byas par spros bcas kyi spyod pa'o// de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa blo dang ldan pa mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur sangs rgyas rnams kyi gar gyi dang klu'i/ ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ / dgos pa/ gar dang glu la rab zhen pa'i/ /sems can glu gar gyi sgo nas| rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ / khang pa rtseg ma byas nas sangs rgyas kyi gar byed pa'i dus su khang pa'i yang thog gi lte ba la slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor du zhugs la yol bas bcad la der rnal 'byor pa lnga'i rnal 'byor du zhugs/ bud med bzhi lha mo bzhi'i 'dra 'bag tu zhugs/ gcig yang mi g.yo mgon gyi 'dra 'bag tu zhugs te de rnams la smod pa skad zer ba/ sangs rgyas gar mkhan rgyu zhing g.yo ba/ rol pa mdzad/

/sangs rgyas gar rgyu zhing g.yo/ mkhan rdo rje yis/ / glu gar gyi sgo nas 'dod yon lnga la/ 'dod chags can gyi byang chub bsgrub/ / lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas glu gar la spyad pas tshogs sog lcags kyi gong bu'i dpes/ de nas rdo rje can byung ste/ /me tog snyim par te thal mo rang dbul ba'i/ rab sbyor bas/ /sems can 'di ltar dam bca' ba| kun la phan ldan pa'i/ /dam tshig der ni bshad par bya/ /sems can ji snyed pa rnams/ sems can du bsdu bas bsdus pa/ sgo nga las skyes pa skye gnas kyis bsdus na bzhi ste/ 'am/ mngal las skyes pa'am/ drod gsher las skyes pa'am/ brdzus te skyes pa'am/ gzugs can gzugs kyi phye na gnyis/ rnams sam gzugs med pa gnyis ma rtogs pas/ can rnams sam/'du bsam pas phye na gsum/ shes can rnams sam | 'du shes med pa can nyid rnams sam/ 'du shes med pa ba rnams sam/ sems can de rnams thams cad bdag gis phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par zhes dam bca'/ bya'o/ / zhes smra/ dam sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par bya ba de 'da' bar mi bya ba/ tshig che bshad de nas ni/ /zur mig mi g.yo mgon mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pas/ phyung ste/ /mi ye shes nam mkha' ltar mtshon pas/ bskyod ye shes chos kyi dbyings nyid kyi/ mnyes ldan pa'i/ /ston pa slob dpon/ la ni rnam par kha la smod la don la bstod/ smod/ /ci khyod kyi/ dam tshig nyid kyi dam tshig ci lags hūm̐ zer 'og hūm̐ gang zhe na/ zhes bya/ / 'o na/ thub thugs kyi hūm̐ zhes zlos pa ste gzhu 'gengs sam/ pa chen don la thub pa| po gzhu chang zung dang stod dang smad dang rgyud dang mde'u la sogs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug chen po dang tshangs pa dang nor rgyas glog tu bsams nas kha hūm̐ gis 'gengs pas/ can yin/ /nga bdag gnyis dang bral/ min snying rje'i rtog pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral/ stobs

bya/ dpal chos dbyings ye shes/ na/ / rtog pa 'joms/ nga stobs dang ldan pas zer bas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa/ stobs zhe sdang gi stobs bcom/ bcom pa min nam don la bstod/ ci/ / nyid kyi dam tshig ci lags oṃ/ 'og ma rnams la 'gre'o/ / ci rnam snang*/ khyod dam tshig oṃ zhes snying po don gyis stong pa'i yid tsam bya/ / don la mi gnas pa/ khyod ni tshangs pa thub pa'am bral ze yin no zhes smod/ rnams// nga bdag dang bral ba/ min rnam par don gyis stong pa'i yid tsam/ snang mdzad gnyis med kya ིdpal | | nyon mongs pa'i khyod ni me bcom 'dod pa rnam snang la me bcom bya ba sgra'i 'then pos 'gro/ bral/ / lo don la 'dod de 'khor 'das kyi 'dod pa dang bral/ 'od dpag med/ ci khyod dam tshig 'gre'o a snying po/ ka sha zhes bya/ / don la nam mkha'i rang bzhin no// mnga' a ā ka sha de/ bdag nam/ mkha'i lding nam grub pa thob bam grub thob/ mkhyen nam ci/ /nga mkha' lding gi grub pa thob pa ma yin/ min pad+ma gar dbang dpal/ / ye shes gar gyis sems can gyi bsam pa tshim pa/ khyod yin pas bzhad gad mkhan yin nam zhes kha la smod/ ni gar mkhan nyer bzhag mkhan/ / don la pad+ma gar mkhan yin zhes bstod pa/ ci khyod dam tshig 'gre/ traṃ zhes traṃ tsha traṃ zhes byas na gdugs traṃ gi gzugs gdugs lta bu yin pas rtog pa 'phrogasnying po/ bya/ / ba yin pas/ khyod ni gdugs te tsha ba don rtogs pa'i/ 'phrog / pa'i gdugs lta bu yin pas/ nga min ye shes kyi/ rdo rje nyi nyon mongs pa'i mun pa sel/ ma dpal/ /gdugs nyi ma yin pas spang bya 'joms| kyi rnam khyod ci shugs la bstod/ ltar nga min zhes lan/ min/ /ci don grub/ khyod dam 'gre/ tshig khaṃ snying po/ zhes bya/ kha ā ka sha khyod ni nam/ mkha' stong pa ltar mi dmigs pas| rang bzhin no/ / zhe na/ nga stong pa/ min rdo rje de dang der sprul pa sna tshogs ston pas/ mgyogs 'gro yin/ khyod ni rta

'khor ba'i pha rol du 'gro/ ste pha grong gi rol du/ 'gro/ / 'am zhes smod/ ci khyod dam tshig dam tshig ci yin snying rje chang zer/ snying rje snying po maṃ yin pas ma dā na ste chang*/ chang*/ / chen po'i btung ba/ e ma chang 'tshong gnyis kyi rnam rtog zhu nas ro gcig tu mnyam pa'i yid/ mdzes ma'o/ / myos byed/ mi rtog pas mi g.yo/ g.yo bdag zhes bos nas/ min mā ma chang 'tshong mi rtog pa'i ngo bo/ kī /zhang chung ma/ po'i grong khyer ma ma'i bya ba las zhang po'i chung ma bya bar 'gro/ 'dzin ma ma a ni bdag med ces bya/ nam ci/ /ci khyod dam dam tshig ci yin zhi ba'o// tshig zhi zer rtog pa/ ba lam zhes zlos pas nyid/ / yin pas/ bud shes rab/ med g.yo zhi ba ltar tshul 'chos pas/ sgyu 'dzin nam ci/ /bdag ni ma yin lha mo spyan/ /spyan phyin ci ma log par rtogs pas/ yin na ni g.yo zur mig tu lta bas sgyu can yin/ dang bcas/ / kha la smod don la bstod/ ci khyod paṃ zhes zlos pas zag med bde ba la/ dam tshig gang zhe na/ 'dod chags dam tshig ci lags dod gas che zer/ gnyis kyis stong pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bas/ che/ / ba'o| | smad de ltar na/ 'tshong ma mā ma kī smod pa/ la ci zag med kyi ye shes sems can la ster bas de las lhag pa'i bstod pa med do// smrar yod// gnyis dang*/ bdag min lha mo gos dkar mo// ci gang dang bral nas/ ltar dri ma dkar dkar mos zhus par ma byas sam zer/ ba yin/ /ci khyod dam tshig taṃ zhes zlos pas/ dbang byed che/ /btsun 'jig rten gyi khams su sprul ba du mas rjes su 'dzin pas/ mo'i pho nya yin nam ci/ /bdag min steng dang 'og tu lta ba ste 'khor 'das mnyam pa'o// zur mig sgrol ma'o/ /sgrol ma mig ni bcom spang bya'i rtog pa thams cad bcom pas/ pa yin/ /mig thog mar sgrol mas gleng slong ba ni/ yon po zhes bos nas/ bdag cag thams cad/ ni nor gnyis med ye shes kyi/

dpal dang*/ ldan/ /de slob dpon gyis/ ltar sems can gyi don mi mdzad pas/ ngo a tsa las smra ba/ tsha med pas legs/ / sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes bskul pa'o de rnams kun gyi/ ngo tsha med pas khyod cag sangs rgyas min/ / ngas/ mthong ba/ dang mi khyod kyi spyod yul/ mthun nyung ngu smros/ /de nas mthong ba dang ji ltar mi mthun zhe na/ rdo rje mig yon po smod pa skad zer ba/ pos gsungs pa/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa ni zhe sdang la sogs pa rnam par dag pa de ltar sbyang*/ sems dpa' zhe sdang rtog pa la/ che/ /thub pa rnam par snang mdzad mi rtog pa/ rmongs/ / bde ba la/ 'dod la zhen pa 'jig rten bdag | ser mi rtog pa la/ sna byed/ rdo rje snang byed de/ /don bde ba chen po'i/ yod skyon ni thams cad byed/ /'dren gong ma bzhi ka dang*/ pa lnga ni skyon zhes slob dpon gyis dang kha la smod don la bstod/ ldan no/ / des na mthong ba dang mi mthun/ sgong skyes mngal nas skyes pa'am | | drod gsher skyes dang de bzhin du zer/ mtha' 'khob gzhan yang mthong ba dang mi mthun pa de dang por sems can thams cad bsgral bar dam bcas pa la sems can da dung ma bsgral bar 'dug ces pa'o// bzhin/ /gzugs can rnams dang gzugs med dam/ /brdzus nas skyes pa nyid dang ni/ /thams cad sangs rgyas bya'o zhes/ khyod kyis dang por gsungs pa ni/ khyod nyid gong du/ sangs rgyas gyur nas ni/ /de rnams ji ltar rgyal ba'am sangs rgyas su/ ma mdzad/ / pas/ de nyid phyir na brdzun gsungs pa/ /mnga' bdag ji ltar 'di ra brdzun/ ma gsungs/ /sems can bslus nas khyod kyis gang | | sangs rgyas nyid de des na sangs rgyas ma yin zhes/ ngo mtshar rmad/ / bdud/ 'chi dus nam gyi dus su bya ba/ ba'i tshe rtags byung ba'i/ 'am 'tshe/ mu ge 'am/ /phas kyi rgol pa'i zer/ 'khor lo gnod pa'am/ /rab gnas dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ / char med pa dang sdig pa dang bkra mi shis pa

zhi bar bya/ ba la/ /sngags mi g.yo ba'i/ dang sgom par ldan par ni/ /gang zhig lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'dod yon lnga la/ bdag ni brtag gi gar byed pa zer/ rol pa//de yi mdun du bdag 'dug cing byin gyis rlob/ ste/ / der ni brdzun du mi 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon rigs lnga'i 'dra 'bag tu bzhag lnga dang lha mo bud med bzhi/ bzhi 'i / / 'dra 'bag tu bzhag mi g.yo'i 'dra 'bag bdag nyid smod pa po/ / dkyil 'khor khang pa'i gnas nyid du/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la/ rol par mdzad/ / de dag gi 'dra 'bag ci la bya zhe na khams dang gser dang shing rtsa dang zer| 'dul de bzhin rtsa ba'am/ / 'khar gong rul pa/ 'dag pa las byas pa/ yi yang rgyan rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gar la sogs pa la spyad pas/ gar mkhan gyi gar// bde thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa/ ba dga' bar byed dang bcas/ /chos yul 'khor gyi'am bha ga'i/ 'byung grong khyer gzhal yas/ nyams dga' bde ba chen po skye ba'i gnas yin pas/ bar | | rdo rje dam tshig glu gar bya ba las mi 'da' bas/ glu yis dang*/ /rdo rje rdo rje gcig pa la sogs pa/ rkang pa'i gom pas gar/ /mthar ni rdza rnga lā s+ye sogs/ / kyis glu gar bya/ phyag 'bras bu/ rgya chen po rab ster ba'i/ /de nyid 'dir ni snod ma yin pa la ma bsgrags pa| cher gsang ngo*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' ji bzhin/ /rab tu 'da' bar mi bya ba'i dam tshig 'bad pas bsrung bar bya/ /glu sna tshogs dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ zer yang gar gyis 'dul ba'i gsung*/ gar dang 'dul bar 'jug pa dang*/ / gong gi nam gyi dus su bya dang snyam char dbab pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i bdag nyid che ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa sho lo ka drug cu rtsa dgu 'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po he badz+ra mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur rdo rje gur gyi ting nge 'dzin gang gis gtor ma'i don ston pa'i/ ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/

'byung po chen po'i rnams tshim par byed pa ma gtor ma gsungs pa | nam mkha'i khams gru gsum dkar po kha gyen la bltas pa/ kyi dbus gnas par/ / paṃ gsum las/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po sum rtseg gam dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma la hūm̐ de las mi bskyod pa/ bsgom par bya ( ka ) / / ( ga ) dbang po shar gyi 'dab mar bsam/ /mthar byed lhor ni dgod par bya/ /chu bdag nub kyi 'dab ma la/ /byang du nor sbyin dgod par bya/ /mer ni byin za chen po nyid/ / bden bral mtshams skyong de bzhin no/ /rlung du gnas med bsam par bya/ / dbang ldan du ni 'byung po'i gtso/ / phyogs skyong la bsdu/ zla lha chen brgyad la bsdu/ steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du oṃ la sogs pa/ 'dab brgyad la oṃ brgyad las lha chen brgyad bskyed/ 'di rnams kyis ni lha chen dang phyogs skyong gnyis ka'i mgron dgug rgyu ste/ nyi tshangs pa la sogs dang*/ / tshangs pa'i ris ni dam pa dang*/ / lha chen po la bsdu/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don nyid dang | | dga' ldan mtha' ci rigs par ro/ / bral gnas pa dang*/ /rgyal po chen por gyur pa dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang sgyur nyid dang ni/ /gang zhig 'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang*/ /gtsang ma'i ris lnga/ gnas su gang gnas dang*/ / nub na/ bde ba can du 'dug pa dang*/ /'og min du ni gnas pa dang*/ /'od phyogs skyong*/ zer can du 'jig ri rab kyi byang na yod gsung*/ rten khams/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa lha dang phyogs skyong la bsdu/ dang*/ /de kun steng du gnas par bya/ /chos 'byung pad+ma sum rtseg gi 'og tu bsdu/ nang du son pa ni/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang*/ /de bzhin mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan nyid/ /pad chen pad+ma bzang po can/ /lha de dag gi snying kha'i a las 'od 'phros pas/ min sems can dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro/

rnams/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'og tu'o/ / 'og gi brgyad la bsdu/ ( kha ) oṃ dkar po dgu/ las tshangs pa la sogs lha/ /hūm̐ nag po dgu/ las ma chag pa la sus kyang nga rgyal 'chag ma myong ba ste dbang po/ sogs/ /a dmar po dgu/ las stobs kyi rgyu la sogs/ /lag gnyis gdong gcig ldan rnams te/ /steng gi lha rnams dkar po che/ /dbang po la sogs nag po mtshungs/ /stobs kyi rgyu sogs dmar po che/ /rang mtshungs rig mas lus spras nas/ /rdo rje dril bus lag pa brel | | g.yas brkyangs pas ni stan la gnas/ / ( ca ) tshangs dbang bskur ba'i rjes la| sogs rtag pas phyag rgya gdab/ /mchod dbang po/ sbyin brgya sogs rdo rje yis// stobs kyi rgyu sogs gar dbang gis/ /thams cad rigs gsum las skyes pa'o | | ( nga ) dkar mos byin gyis brlab pa/

dgug par byas nas ni/ /chom rkun mas ni zhags bcings nas/ /ro langs mas ni sgrog bcing bas/ /ghasma rī ni dril bu'i dbang*/ /de ( cha ) nas mchod yon zhabs bsil dbul/ / ni mtshon pa tsam ste mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa dang oṃ in+d+ra sogs kyis bstab pa dang bstod pa dang las bcol ba sogs byas la/ sngags ni 'di yis bsang gtor bya/ /oṃ ā hūm̐/ phyis ni 'thor 'thung kha bshal gyi dod chu gcig dbul bar bya/ /sngags 'di yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra rdo rje/ satwa sems dpa'/ sa mā ya/ dam tshig ma nu rjes su/ pā la ya/ skyongs shig dri brtan pa'i*/ ḍho me bdag bhā/ rang bzhin du/ ba/ su mdzes pa'i/ to ṣ+yo me bdag bhā rang bzhin du/ ba/ dga' ba'i su to ṣ+yo me/ bdag bhā ba rang bzhin du/ swa dbugs dbyung ba'i/ swa to me bdag bhā ba/ rang bzhin du/ a rjes su chags pa'i/ nu rak+to me bdag bhā ba/ rang bzhin du/ hri snying po/ da yam+me bdag la/ a shin tu mnos par dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba thams cad/ sid+dhi dngos grub/ me bdag la/ pra yats+tsha gsol/ sarba thams cad/ karma bya ba/ su tsa stsol cig m+meb dag la| tsi ta sre snying la gnas par/ ya ku mdzod cig 'di kun la sbyar/ ru hūm̐ dbyings/ hūm̐ ye shes/ haḥhaḥ ye shes bzhi/ haḥhaḥho bha ga bcom ldan 'das/ wan sarba thams cad ta thā ga de bzhin gshegs pas/ ta mā me muñca bdag ma gtong*/ badz+ri rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ bhā ba sa ma ya dam tshig sems dpa'/ de yan chad la yi ge brgya yod/ satwa āḥmuḥ mu brgya la mi gtogs/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur rdo rje'i ming gi ting nge gsang dbang gi rab byed las bzhi rigs gcig de'ang dngos po rnam snang mthar mi bskyod gsung na/ dang po mi bskyod pa nas rim pa bzhin du ye shes so/ / 'dzin la zhugs te/ rdo rje'i ming phye ba'o/ /ming gi dbang gi dus su ni/ /slob ma bdag nyid

ming gi dbang bskur ba'i dus su lha gang la me tog gi phreng ba phog pa de las ming dras nas btags pas sangs rgyas pa'i ming yang de'i ming du 'gyur/ yang na gsang ba'i dbang bskur tsam na mi gcig ā li kā li bgrang du bcug la byang sems babs pa dang bstun te de las dras pa'i ming btags pas sangs rgyas tsam na yang de skad bya bar 'gyur nges/ dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ / bzhad pa'i zhe sdang*/ rdo rje dang*/ sgeg pa'i swa to me bhā ba/ a nu rak+to me bhā ba/ hri da yam+me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba me sid+dhi pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa m+metsi ta sre ya ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ haḥhaḥhaḥhaḥho bha ga wan sarba ta thā gta mā me muñca bhā ba sa ma ya badz+ri satwa āḥmuḥde nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur rdo rje'i ming gi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/ rdo rje'i ming phye ba'o/ /ming gi dbang gi dus su ni/ / slob ma bdag nyid dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bzhad pa'i zhe sdang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mdzes mo ha/ pa'i rdo rje dang*/ rol pa'i zhe sdang*/ pa'i rdo rje dang*/ shin tu rat+na dga' ba'i rdo rje dang*/ shin tu dga' zhe sdang*/ ba myu gu'i rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma 'dod chags/ rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma myu gu 'dod chags/ rdo rje dang*/ a la la zhe sdang*/ rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma rā ga lcags kyu gsang dbang gi na 'di gnyis/ rdo rje dang*/ ye shes mo ha rdo rje dang yid bzhin rat+na/ nor bu rdo rje dang*/ yan lag rat+na/ med pa'i gcig go/ rdo rje dang*/ shes rab las myu gu'i rdo rje'i dang*/ snying rje'i myu gu'i las/ rdo rje dang*/ dam par dga' ha na/ ba'i rdo rje dang*/ shin tu rat+na| bde bar dga' ba'i rdo rje dang*/ gcig spyan ras 'dod chags/ gzigs kyi rdo rje dang | 'jug 'beb zer/

pa'i rdo rje las/ dang*/ nam mkha'i las/ rdo rje dang*/ shes rab las/ rdo rje dang*/ pha rol tu phyin mo ha/ pa'i rdo rje dang*/ 'dod chags rā ga drug rigs gcig tu'o// rdo rje ni 'di bde/ dag pa'i 'og min du/ gnas su phyag rgya chen po grub pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas tsam na'i/ rdo rje'i ming ni 'di rnams da lta'i ming 'di ltar bstan pa| so/ /bud med da lta btags la sangs rgyas tsam na'ang*/ rnams kyi 'byung ste/ rdo rje dhe sha snyems ma dang*/ rdo rje dhe sha mtshon cha ma dang*/ rdo rje e dhe sha ma'o bde ma dang*/ rdo rje dhe sha bdag med ma dang*/ /rdo rje mo ha/ spyan ma drug dang gcig / rdo rje mo ha/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ rdo rje dkar mo mo ha/ dang*/ rdo rje mo ha/ sgyu ma dang*/ rdo rje 'bar rat+na/ ma dang*/ rdo rje 'khril rat+na/ shing ma dang*/ rdo rje mgyogs rat+na/ ma dang*// rdo rje ro rat+na ro langs ma dang*/ drug gcig rdo rje rat+na/ lcags kyu ma dang*/ rdo rje rat+na/ a ba li dang*/ rdo rje rā ga phreng ba ma dang*/ rdo rje rā ga lā s+ye ma dang*/ rdo rje rā ga bzhad ma dang*/ rdo rje rā ga 'khyud ma drug gcig dang*/ rdo rje rā ga phye ma dang*/ rdo rje rā ga pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje 'byung ma las/ dang*/ rdo rje chu srin zer/ chen mo las/ dang*/ rdo rje 'dod chags rā ga ma dang*/ rdo rje las/ sgrol ma dang*/ drug gcig rdo rje do shal las/ ma dang*/ rdo rje dhe sha sgeg mo dang*/ rdo rje blo gros las/ ma dang*/ rdo rje kong las/ ma ( ka ) nā dang*/ rdo las/ rje la ma zer/ nar ma kha chu zer/ dang*/ rdo rje las/ dbugs dbyung ma dang | rdo rje las rnam pa ma ni/ bdun gcig mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi'o/ /de nas de bzhin rigs lnga po de rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs bstan/ gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan du gyur pa/ kye yi rdo rje rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rnam grangs/ sems dpa' dang*/ / rnam snang chen po dang ni rang 'byung

gi ye shes/ dang*/ /rdo rje ra li skem pa'i khro bo dang | | de bzhin du yang rdo rje khro bo nyid/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdud rtsi thal sbyor dang | | he ru ka dang snying rje'i stobs nyid do/ / bcu gcig rtag pa dang ni gti mug rdo rje dang*/ /rnam par snang mdzad dang ni thams cad skyob/ /sgyu 'phrul dang ni de nas oṃ mdzad dang*/ /sku yi rdo rje rab tu grags pa dang*/ /sa snying dang ni gti mug chen po dang*/ /gshin rje gshed dang tho ba'i dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs dang shākya thub pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas zhes byar rab tu grags pa'o/ / bcu bzhi rdo rje nyi ma de nas rin chen bdag /de bzhin du yang rin chen rgyal po nyid | | rdo rje gzi brjid dang ni rgyal po che/ /rdo rje bdud zil gnon dang snang byed do/ / bdun/ rta mgrin dang ni 'jig rten bdag po dang*/ /rdo rje chos dang spyan ras gzigs dang ni/ /pad+ma gar dbang dang ni 'dod chags dang*/ /'jig rten mgon po rab tu grags pa'o/ /dam pa'i rta dang rta yi rgyal po dang*/ /bdun gyi rgyal po de nas lcags rgyal dang*/ /dam tshig rdo rje dang ni rta mchog dang*/ /de bzhin du yang las kyi rdo rje nyid/ /don yod dang ni don yod grub pa dang*/ /rdo rje mgyogs 'gror rab tu grags pa'o/ / bcu/ rdo rje sems dpa' de nas rdo rje can | | rnam par rgyal ba phyag na rdo rje can/ /dpe med ro mnyam shin tu dga' ba dang*/ /dam pa dang po bde ba chen po'o/ / dgu/de dag mdor bsdu na 'dod 'od dpag med/ chags zhe mi bskyod/ sdang gti rnam snang/ mug dang*/ / gsum ni sbyang gzhi las dris/ dam don grub/ phrin las/ tshig ste phrin las kyi ngo bo yin la de phrin las su bya ba las mi 'da' bas/ sems rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo/ ngo bo/ dpa' nor bu rin yon tan 'byung*/ ni/ /'di rnams rigs ni drug tu brjod/ / mngon 'dod phyag rgya chen po/

pa'i phrin las/ thar nges/ pa nang don ming 'di rnams bsdus pas brgya nyi shu'o// rab bsgrub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan gyi le'u sho lo ka sum cu so dgu dang rkang pa gcig bzhugs so// ste gsum mo// // rdo brtag gnyis dang po yin zer/ kha gcig sum cu rtsa gnyis las bsdus pa yin zer sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi tha ma gnyis yin no// rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po nyid | | sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ /rdo rje gar ni pad+ma gar dbang*/ gsum pa'o// gar gyi brtag pa rang gsung*/ bzhi pa sna tshogs karma brtag pa zhes/ /rdo rje'i brtag pa mi bskyod pa'i/ lnga pa'o/ /brtag pa drug pa khro bo/ stobs po che 'i / / don ston pa/ brtag pa bdun pa mi g.yo mgon/ /brgyad pa mang po nyid/ gzungs kyi lha mo rnams kyi/ brtag pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ku ru kul+le dgu/ / 'byung po/ bcu rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa/ pa 'dul ba'i 'jig rten brtag pa bcu pa'o zer/ brtag pa ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcu gcig pa//dngos dman pa dang thun mong mchog gsum ka' ི / grub brtag pa bcu gnyis pa// sgrol ma'i brtag pa bcu gsum pa/ /rdo rje phag mo bcu bzhi pa/ /bco lnga pa rdo rja ེ / ni gzi 'od zer can zer/ brjid che/ /bdag med brtag pa bcu drug pa/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bcu bdun pa/ /hūm̐ mdzad la ni bco brgyad pa/ /dbyangs can gyi so sor 'brang ma'i/ ni bcu dgu pa/ / zer/ sbyin bsreg brtag pa nyi shu pa/ /rab gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ /dkyil he ru ka'i gzugs can gyi/ 'khor chen po'i brtag pa he ru ka bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bris/ ni//nyi shu rtsa gnyis su ni brjod/ / gtor ma'i brtag pa nyi shu gsum/ /nyi shu bzhi pa sta gon la/ gnas/ / pa ston pa'i ldog pa/ mngon rigs lnga'i/ par rtogs pa 'i rim pa ston pa/ nyi shu lnga/

/de bzhin sku gsung thugs| phyag rgya nyi shu drug / lha rnams la gang gis rgyas gdab pa bdams pa'i rtog pa rig pa'am las phran tshegs/ byed pa mnyam pa zer nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /glu ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ / gar gyi dbang phyug brtag pa ni/ /sum cur nyi shu dgu/ gcig med sum cu pa/ / brtag pa ri chang gi pa sum cu de kun gyi kha skong*/ par zer/ ni bshad/ /stong phrag brtag pa re la le'u/ sum cu'i grangs kyis ni// ( 1 )( 3 ) mkha' 'gro 'i brtag pa'o// mkha' 'gro ma 'i brtag pa/ rnams kyi/ / ( 2 ) 'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che na / / po dang 'dra ba'i| kye'i rdo rje rdor 'chang gi / sa gsungs pa'i/ rgyud ni e ma rgyas par bstan/ / pa sum cu bsdus pas/ ( 4 ) 'bum phrag mnga' bdag kye'i rdo rje'i/ / gang gtso bo'am gces pa/ dag pa'i snying brtag pa gnyis su/ po'i snying po 'di ni yongs bsdus pa'o zer/ yongs bzung ba// rdo rje mkha' 'gros bsdus te/ gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud kyi nges rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na sum cu/ bsdus pas gnyis su nges pa'o/ /kye'i rdo rje rnal rgyud kyi rim pa ni ji ltar dgos ched gang gi ched du zhe na/ 'byor rgyud/ /dang por rgyal ba rnams skyes pa rnams gzung ba'i don du brtag pa gong ma/ kyis bshad/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor ma brtag pa 'og ma/ rgyud ni/ /de nyid bud med gzung phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyas par sum cu bshad pas chog pa la/ ji ltar na spros pa las brtag pa gnyis su/ bsdus pa lags/ lan du/ bskal pa bzang po la 'di la skyes pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ so so'i skye bo slob dpon dang slob ma/ rnams tshe thung ba dang dbang po zhan/ par 'gyur na/ ji ltar na rgyud rgyas pa/ de rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ ji ltar na de rnams thos par byed/ 'gyur/ ji ltar na sems gsang sngags/ par 'gyur/ te long med pas sems pa la sogs par mi 'gyur pas rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na skye bo phal pa tshe thung bar 'gyur | rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ re zhig gang dag so so skye bo'i sems/ slob dpon rnams su 'gyur ba de rnams rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ de'i dbang gis tshe thung bar 'gyur ba/ gang dag spyod pa po de rnams mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la spyod par 'gyur bas kyang tshe thung*/ ba dang*/ gang dag so so'i skye bo de dag srog chags gsod par 'gyur bas kyang tshe thung*/ ba dang*/ gang dag ma mo 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma 'i tshogs rnams gcig tu 'dod pa la zhen par 'gyur ba ste/ de'i phyir na dus ma yin par gsod pas/ rgyud rnams thams cad kyi bstan pa rgyas pa ma yin no/ / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa/ thams cad ston pa po/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rtogs par dka' ba'i/ thos nas/ mnyes gong du rgyud rgyas pa dang bsdus pa bstan pas/ par gyur cing dgyes pa rnyed rgyud bsdus pa gang zag tshe thung ba la sogs pa'i don du/ nas tshig 'di gsungs pa/ snying rje chen khro bo bzhugs pa shin tu snying rje bar ston/ po kye rdo rje/ /nga rtog pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral te/ ni dur khrod chu 'gram mi bskyod pa'i gnas/ dang*/ /nags tshal skye bo med grong du/ / snying rje chen po kye'i rdo rje yod/ bsnyen bkur can phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa rnams/ la mi bskyod pa'i/ dngos grub ster/ /mtsho rnam snang gi gnas/ skyes rnam pad+ma/ pa'i 'gram yid 'ong*/ / sku gdung sha ri ra yin nges pa bzhugs pa'i/ gdung bzang po'i bzhugs pa/ mchod rten dang*/ / rkang 'thung shing gi rtsa ba gcig pa/ rlon pa'i 'og tu de'i rtsar bsgrubs na/ ni/ /nga ni sangs rnam snang*/ rgyas rnam snang gi dngos grub ster/ /tshong rin po che'i/ 'dus grong ldar nyid rdo rje nyi ma'i dngos grub kyi gnas/

dang ni/ /tshong 'dus rnam pa'i khyim du ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rtogs pa mi g.yo ba/ brtan pa dang*/ /bsnyen bkur can la bsgrub pa nyams su len pa/ dngos grub rin 'byung ga ིster/ /glu gar rab snang mtha'i gnas/ tu 'ching lag pa/ pa dang*/ /chang 'tshong ma yi khyim du ni/ /'di ltar pad+ma gar mkhan dang | | bsnyen bkur bsgrub pa nyams su len pa/ can la dngos snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ grub ster | | rtag tu don yod grub pa'i gnas/ mgyogs 'gro zhon pa'i tshe sgom/ gyur te/ /res 'ga' lam du rkang thang du/ 'gro ba na/ /rta ni don yod rdo rje 'dzin/ brtan pa dang*/ / dngos grub rdo rje dang 'dra ba mi phyed pas/ rnams ster ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur phyag

sku gsung thugs/ rgya rnam tha mal pa'i rtog pa las| par rgyal ba'i ting de mngon du byed pa/ nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ sku gsung thugs/ phyag rgya dang yang na bstan bshad/ phyag mtshan thugs/ yang dag par bshad pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi brtag pa las/ / rtog pa la/ phyag rgya rnam gsum shes par bya/ /sku 'i bya ba la lag pa'i phyag rgyaX sku'i/ yin/ /sngags rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lces/ zhes ༷pa ni hūm̐ gis rdo rje sbyangs pa'i sor mos rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa 'chang ba'o// bzlas pa las ngag phyag rgya/ / sems la mtshan ma'i 'khor lo dang rin po che la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bsnams pa thugs kyi phyag rgya yin/ / phyi rol du ma zad bsgom pa'i dus na yang phyag rgya gang dang ldan par bsam/ de nyid bsam gtan gyi mtshan ma ste thugs kyi mtshan mo'o// dkyil 'khor lo'o/ /lag rnam snang gi 'khor gyi lha mo/ pa g.yas na skam pa de rnams spyir phyag rgya bstan 'di rnams bye brag tu thugs kyi bstan/ stai/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub de bzhin no/ /mkha' phrin las/ 'gro skam pa gti mug 'joms pa/ ma 'asngigs ma/ / de/ gdug rmongs/ pa rnams skam pa mas rmongs pa 'don| kyi 'khur ba zug rngu zer/ nas lam/ 'don/ / pa dang 'dra'o// g.yas pa'i lag na zhags pa ste/ /gdug pa rnam bcing rnam par dgug /de bzhin zhags pa ma zhes bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /g.yas na nya rgya zlum po ste | | gdug pa rnams ni bkri bar 'dod ( 1 ) / / ( 3 ) 'di ni rtag tu dol zlum bshad | | ( 2 ) g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /lag pa g.yas par lcags kyu ste/ /gdug pa rnams ni dgug par 'dod ( 1 ) / / ( 3 ) 'di de rdo rje kyo mar bshad/ / ( 2 ) g.yon pas gdug la sdigs mdzub mtshams kyi me tog la sogs pa go sla/ ma/ /lag rdo rje nyi ma'i de bzhi/ pa g.yas pas nyi ma gti mug gi mun pa 'joms/ ste/ /gti phrin las/ mug mun pa rnam par 'dral/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mar ni bshad/

/'di ni rdo rje nyi mar brjod/ /lag g.yas mar me'i sdong snod de ( 1 ) | | ( 3 ) de bzhin g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bo/ /'di ni rdo rje mar mer bshad | | ( 2 ) rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib 'joms/ / ( 4 ) lag pa g.yas 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa/ na rin po che/ /sems can rnams la sbyin pa ster/ /g.yon par sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /rin chen sgron mar 'di rab brjod/ /glog thog ni zer/ ni lag pa g.yas par te/ /rnam par rtog pa'i chu sbyin te sprin/ 'joms/ /de 'di glog lag mar shes bya/ /de bzhin g.yon par sdigs sgeg mo la sogs go sla/ mdzub ma/ /lag pa g.yas par pad+mar pad+ma gar dbang gis bzhi/ te/ /pad+ma'i 'dod chags 'dod chags kyi ngo bo yin pas des ma gos pa/ brjod par bya/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub ma nyid de/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro pad+mar brjod/ /g.yas par bha ga'i rnam pa pad+ma thogs pa/ ste/ / bha ga la brten nas/ bde phrin las/ ba chen po rnam par 'phel/ / g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin ma ste/ /'di ni chos 'byung mar ni brjod/ / g.yas pa'i lag na lcags sgrog ste/ /byang chub yongs su mi gtong*/ zhen pas sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las gzhan du 'gror mi ster ba/ kun 'ching ba/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin ma ste/ /'di ni rdo rje sgrog mar brjod/ /sangs rgyas rjes snying rjes sems can gyi don la/ su chags pa yis/ / don yal bar mi 'dor ba/ bdag nyid snying rjes/ 'khyud par 'dod pa gdul bya mi gtong bar/ ste/ /byang chub chags pas bsten/ rab bsgrub bsten pa lam du byed pa/ ma/ /'di ni rdo rje 'khyud mar gling bu ma la sogs pa go sla'o/ / bshad/ / g.yas pa'i lag na sgo lcags don yod grub pa'i 'khor/ te/ /ye shes kun gyis rtog pa las| srung ba mo/ /g.yon na sdig mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de rdo rje sgo lcags brjod | | g.yas pa'i lag tu lde kyog gis sgo drangs te gcod pa bzhin/ ste/ /ye shes

mngon du/ blangs nas rtog pa/ gcod pa mo/ /g.yon ni sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ / 'di de rdo rje lde kyog brjod/ /g.yas pa'i lag pas sgo mo yis bcad de nor mi gtong ba bzhin/ ni/ /ye shes rgyud la gnyis su med pa'i/ skyes pa ma spangs mi 'dor/ pa'o/ / g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de rdo rje sgo mar brjod/ /lag pa g.yas par yol ba sa bcad nas btsun mo bsrung ba bzhin/ ni/ /rang ye shes/ mtshungs btsun mo mi nyams par/ srungs pa nyid/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /rdo rje yol ba mar ni mtshams ma rnams kyi gong du bstan zer/ brjod/ /'di gong du bstan pa'i lha mo rnams/ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / 'khor du gyur pa/ mkha' 'gro ma yi dam pa'i tshogs | | ye shes kyi snang bar gyur pa'i/ mkha' 'gro dgos pa/ lnga 'i dngos grub/ ni rab tu/ bsgrub bar bya ba'i/ phyir/ /mkha' lha mo gtso bor byas pa/ 'gro ma yi rgyud gsungs so/ / de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad gong gi/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'i zhes bya ba'i/ gsung thos nas/ ngo zhes pa de'i don phyed par dka' bas/ mtshar skyes par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das ḍā ki'i sgra de/ phyag rgya 'phrog pa 'di ci nyi tshe saṃ skṛ ta 'ba' zhig ba'i dam tshig phyag ngag gi rgya sgrub pa/ 'phrog sgrub po zer/ pa lags 'da' bar mi bya bar/ sam/ 'on te gzhan gyi yang yod ce na/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'og min gyi gnas kyi bye brag 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ rdo rje rgyud kyi mtshan/ nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i legs par brjod pa zer| lung bstan pa yod de ḍā ki ni zhes pa 'od zer gyi sgra las btus pa/ 'di ni de'i yin te/ ḍā+e bā+e h+ya sa byings las nam mkhar 'gro ma zhes zer/ ga ma ne'i skad kyi dbyings 'dis rnam par brtag pa ste/

sangs rgyas/ thams ḍā+e/ cad kun tu gnas/ nam dus dang phyogs bā+e/ mkhar longs spyod/ spyod ha/ par grub gang 'dod/ pas/ ya/ 'di ni mkha' 'od zer can la thams cad ces pa ming gi dang po ḍā+e/ nam mkha'i dang po bā+e/ spyod pa'i dang po ha/ grub pa'i ming gi dang po ya bzhi po 'di bsdoms pas/ 'gro mar rab tu grags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad tshig 'di saṃ skṛ ta'i skad ma yin te 'od zer can gyi tshig yin par bstan pa de/ thos nas dga' ba dang mgu ba nye bar thob par gyur nas/ tshig 'di dag gsol pa/ e ma mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud/ / dkyil 'khor gtsor ston pa'i/ rgyud kun las ni dam pa ste zer/ phyi ma bla na med pa'i rgyud/ dang*/ / tshig nyung bas/ rtogs sla don mang bas ma bshad na/ rtogs par dka' ba dang*/ /rig gong gi don rab tu sbyar/ dang mi rig pa nyid do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mi rtog pa/ byang chub mnyam pas/ sems dpa' rnams kyis sems 'og nas kyi lan 'debs/ bskul ba'i phyir 'di skad gsungs so/ / bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'di la rdo rje gur rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'dir ji ltar rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor rgyud 'di'i nang du/ bsdu ba yin/ / gong mar rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /sgong skyes la sogs bsgral lo zhes/ /byang chub tu smon sngon brjod nas/ /ci phyir btsun mo'i rnams bor bya/ /srog chags gsod la 'bad ldan dang*/ /dam pa ste zer/bla na med pa'i rgyud/tshig nyung bas/don mang bas ma bshad na/ gong gi don rab tu sbyar/ mi rtog pa/mnyam pas/'og nas kyi lan 'debs/dkyil 'khor rgyud 'di'i nang du|de bsdus pa la dgos pa med do zhe na/ byams de bsdus pa la dgos pa med do zhe na/ pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol ba/

sgo nga las skyes pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa ngas srid pa gsum ste lus ngag yid gsum zhen pa las bsgral bar bya'o zhes phyag rgya chen po la dgod do zhes/ smon lam sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub gong du le'u gnyis pa'i rdo rje gar gyi skabs su/ rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs na/ ci'i sems can la phan par bya ba gsungs pa las 'di/ phyir na srog chags rnams byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sems can la bskyab par gsungs na 'dir mngon spyod bya bar gsungs pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin par rang gi phyag rgya yang spang bar gsungs na 'dir bsten pa/ de gnyis byang sems la mi gnod dam zhe na log lta can snying rjes gsod la btsun mo ni rgyud 'dir mi spong ngo zhes gsung pa'o/ / gsad pa bsgral bar/ dang*/ gcig mi tshangs par spyod pa mi spang ba'i phyir tu 'dod pas de'i bsten pa'i btsun mo rnams kyang de spang bar mi rigs par rgyud gyi nang du bsdus so// spang par gsungs pa| lags/ na 'dir bsten pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ lta ba yang dag pa'i/ las ni log log lta las bzlog ste yang dag pa'i lta ba la dgod pa rnams dang*/ /btsun bde ba'i btsun mo dgos pas/ mo rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud du gtso bor rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor| bshad do/ /bde ba mngon du byed pa 'i thabs ni mdor bsdus pa/ /gzhung gang bsdus zhe na/ nyung la/ don ni rgyas pa ste/ /blau dman pas rtogs sla bas ma rig pa/ rab tu sad par/ byed pa/ /rgyud bla na med pa'i/ kun gyi ni snying por nges/ /sngags rnams yid skyob par byed pas/ kyi ni khyad par gyi sngags yin no// du'o/ /rdo rje ḍā ki ni'i sgra rtogs dka' bas| nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'di rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi che ba| ni bshad nai rāt+mā'i sgrub thabs/ pa tsam gyis ni/ / spyan la sogs pa lha mo gzhan gyi sgrub thabs kyang rtogs par bya ba'i don du zhes/

bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis/ / dga' ste| sngon he badz+ra la/ du nai rāt+mā bsgom pa'i phan yon gyi/ gar gyis snyoms 'jug gsung*/ mchod byas te | | rang gi 'khor bud+dha bodhi la 'di gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam snang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa/ dang*/ /gal te rdo rje chos dpag med/ dang ni/ / rta mchog don yod/ rdo rje nyi ma rin 'byung*/ la'ang*/ /bdag gis spangs te bdag la ma bsten| na mi 'grub te/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yum gyi gzugs kyis rigs lnga'i dngos grub/ skyed par byed/ /de rnams kyis ni mdzes ma btsun mo/ nga*/ / de la nga rnal 'byor ma/ ni dngos grub ster/ /mig grub pa gang ster na/ sman ( 1 ) dang ni rkang ( 2 ) byug dang*/ / ( 3 ) ral gri sa 'og ( 4 ) bsgrub pa dang*/ /ri lu ( 1 ) la gnyis|2'og mi snang ba'i sgrub thabs/ mkha' la spyod pa dang*/ /mi 'di gnyis ril bu snang ba ( 5 ) dang tshe dang lus kyi/ bcud kyis len ( 6 ) / /rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub/ 'khor lo sgyur ba nyid/ / gsum 'dra 'bring gi chen po gsung*/ ( 7 ) bu mo gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa/ dam pa 'gugs pa ni/ / bum pa'i gter dang brgyad 'bring gi'o/ / bdag gnyes pas ni bsgrub pa pos/ /dngos grub ni mi phyed pa'i dngos grub/ rdo rje rnams 'thob bo/ /spros pa nai rāt+mā bsgoms pa'i phan yon/ rnam pa mang por ni/ /smras pa 'dis ni ci zhig bya/ / bdag spangs te nai rāt+mā la ma brten par/ nges par mi dngos grub/ 'grub cing*/ / byang chub bdag med na 'bras bu/ med cing de'i don du/ bsgom pa med/ /gang sgrub pa po/ zhig rtag tu bdag dran zhing*/ /rtag nai rāt+mā ston pa'i rgyud dang sngags tu klog cing sems pa dang | | sngags kyi phreng ba bzlas pa dang*/ /nga yi sku ni sgom byed pa/ /gal te tshul sngi ltar sgom na/ sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sam/ /gal te rmi lam 'dra bar blta/ /shin tu thun mong bzhi/

bsgom pa'i rim pa las/ /mngon bskyed rim mthar phyin tsam na/ sum du ni mthong nai rāt+mā/ bar 'gyur/ / nai rāt+mā'i/ gzugs brnyan ba ( 7 ) bu mo dam pa 'gugs pa ni/ /bdag gnyes pas ni bsgrub pa pos/ /dngos grub 'thob bo/ /spros pa rnam pa mang por ni/ /smras pa 'dis ni ci zhig rdo rje rnams bya/ /bdag spangs nges par mi 'grub cing*/ /byang chub bsgom pa med/ /gang med cing zhig rtag tu bdag dran zhing*/ /rtag tu klog cing sems pa dang*/ /blags kyi phreng ba bzlas pa dang*/ /nga yi sku ni sgom byed pa/ /gal te sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sam/ /gal te rmi lam 'dra bar blta/ /shin tu bsgom pa'i rim pa las | | mngon sum du ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan ba sgom pa'i/ rab tu sbyor ba las/ / nai rāt+mā/ de yi dngos grub sbyin par bya/ /rdo 'du shes gsum ldan du byas nas/ rje pad+ma rab sbyor bas | | shin tu bde ba chen po mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ bde chen bdag med ma dang*/ sbyor ba las | | gang rnal 'byor pa/ zhig bdag phyag rgya bdag med mar bskyed pa/ la 'dod pa bde ba| ster ba/ /lus dngos grub mi ster zhes/ can de 'i brjod pa'i zer/ la phan yon/ smos su zhig brjod zer ci kyis mi lang*/ dgos/ /gang sgrub pos/ zhig bdag med ma/ nyi ma gcig ye shes kyi zag med kyi bde ba/ sgom pa/ /rdo rje 'i stong pa'am snyoms 'jug gi bde ba| mchod pa'i sbyor dngos grub mchod pa/ ba las/ /shes lhan skyes rab pha rol phyin dngos grub/ /ster te 'di la the tshom med*/ / mdorargyas/ bdag sgrub pa po/ nyid he ru kar byas shing*/ /rang gi btsun mo ngar nai rāt+mā/ bsgoms nas/ /gang zhig rnal chags chen gyis ni 'dod spyod gang zer/ 'byor ches 'dod pa/ / snyoms 'jug de rnams la ni nga mnyes 'gyur/ / grogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan zhing*/ /spro 'dod yon lnga la/ ba dga' bar ldan pa dang*/ /glu dang rol sgra'i rnam pa dang*/

/'dod kun bde ba spro ba dang*/ /sna tshogs sgeg par ldan pa dang*/ /sna tshogs ro yi btung ba dang*// sna tshogs gos kyi ri mo can/ /sna tshogs dri yi byug pa yis/ /gang zhig phyag rgya| bdag tu bskyed pa dang sgrub pa po he ru kar bskyed pa/ dang rtag nyal ba/ /de yi dngos grub ster ba dang*/ /phyag lha'i sku rgya chen po'i go 'phang thob pa/ gnas 'dug pa/ /de yi 'dod pa mar btsun mor/ 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a gong gi jags kyi phreng ba zhes pa'i don/ ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au a ཾ swāhā/ gang bsgrub pa po/ zhig 'dis sngags/ nga bskul bar byed pa'i rgyal ba'i sras de rnams kyi yan lag

gam/ tu bud med kyi sgyu ma'i bde ba yang dag pa gnas pa'i phyir/ kyis 'dug go /rdo rje ma 'di'i mngon rtogs le'u bcu gnyis par bstan/ ni shar du sbyin par bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni dkar mo'i gzugs can ma'o/ /nub phyogs su ni chu'i mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /byang du ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /nga dbus su bzhag ste/ snying po nang 'phar dang bcas pa'i phyi 'phar dkyil 'khor du gang zhig bsam par byed pa/ de'i bdag mdzes ma ste/ phyag gnyis zhal gcig ma'o/ /gri gug dang skyes pa'i thod pas brel ba/ stag gi lpags pa bgos pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ shar gyi sgor ni dkar mo chen mo'o/ /lhor ni chom rkun ma'o// nub kyi sgor ni chu ma'o/ /de bzhin du byang du ni ghasma rī'o/ /dbang ldan du ni puk+ka sī'o | | 'tshed pa'i mtshams su ri khrod ma'o/ /srin po'i phyogs su gdol pa mo'o | | rtag tu 'gro rlung du/ bar ni g.yung mo'o/ /'di rnams ni mtshams dang mtshams bral du sbyin no/ / ( ka )( ga ) gang zhig bdag gis gtso byas pa bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor/ rab tu sgom par byed pa de'i lag mthil du phyin pa'i dpal lam dngos grub sus kyang dbrog par mi nus so/ / ( kha ) thams cad kyang kha dog nag por mtshungs pa/ rab srog tu son po'i ro/ steng du gar dang bcas pa/ khro mo chen mo/ dpa' mo/ g.yon gyi mchan khung*/ na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa ma'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje bsnyen pa dang sa dang*/ lhag par gnas pa dang gcig thig dang rdul tshon gyis bri ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang bsgrub pa la sogs pa byas nas slob ma 'jug pa'i cho gas rang nyid dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas rjes su gnang ba'i bar du blangs nas/ slob ma'i gdong g.yogs te ye shes phab brtan phyi'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ gur mchog dbang bskur bas bde ba chen po'i ngo bor byas

tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin he ru ka'i/ ting nge 'dzin la de mngon du byed pa la/ bzhugs te/ rig ma rig pa las bzlog pa'i ma la brten pa 'i dbang yang dag par bshad pa/ rang gi rig ma net+ma dang*/ skyes bu he ru ka gnyis 'od du zhu ba 'i chus/ / gang ba de rnam rgyal bum pa'o// bum pa brgyad po thams cad nas kyang gtso bo'i bum par blugs kyis// kyang dbang bskur/ rdo rje thugs ni slob dpon gyis dag pa bzhis/ rab bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje can mi bskyod par/ bsams nas bum chus/ dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje slob ma nyi ma rab bsgoms slob dpon rang nyid dag pa bzhis bskyed do/ / la/ /der ni dbu rgyan yang dag pa bzhis| sbyin par bya/ /thams 'khor gsum/ cad sngon dag pa bzhis bzhin nges bsams nas | | rdo badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca brjod la/ rje tshigs bcad sbyor ba las//rdo rje chen po nyid dag pa bzhis snang ba mtha' yas yab yum bskyed la snyoms par zhugs pa las zhu bde las rdo rjer gyur pas dbang bskur/ rtse dgu pa/ /snying khar rang gi lag pa yis gzung bar/ byas la / /slob dag pa bzhis ma 'jig rten dbang phyug byas/ /rdo slob dpon rang nyid mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gcig pur gnas kyang chog 'di bde rje sems dpas dbang bskur byas/ /sangs rgyas kyi/ rdo rje'i dbang 'dis ni/ /de ring khyod ni dbang bskur 'gyur/ /'di slob dpon/ de slob ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /bzang grub phyir ni rdo rje zung*/ /slob ma lcags mchog dag pa bzhis/ lha mo ni/ /sgrol mas 'khyud pa bsam par bya/ /lag pas rdo rje yis mtshan pa'i dril dril bu yang dag pa bzhis bskyed la/ 'khrol zhing*/ /rdo rje bdag dril bu/ pos gong mas 'gre/ dbang bskur bya/ / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes gdul bya rnams 'grub pa'i phyir/ oṃ rdo rje'i/ badz+ra a dhi pa bdag po'i ti twāṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya s+t+waṃ | slob ma

dag pa bzhis/ rnam snang byas nas ni/ /ming slob ma'i spyi bor lag pa dril bu dang bcas pa bzhag nas/ gis kyang ni dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra me tog phog pa'i lha las dras te ming 'dogs/ satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye che ge mo rdo rje/ mjug bsdu ba'i tshul gyis rig pa'i dbang lnga po'i mngon rtogs bstan/phung po lnga po/ gang rig pa'i dbang lnga | gang kun gyi rang rigs lngar/ gtsor 'gyur/ / dbang de gzugs sogs/ de bdag med he ru ka /sangs gzugs rnam snang tshor ba rin 'byung sogs/ rgyas ye shes lnga/ 'byung ba'i phyir | | chos kyi phung po lnga/ dbang lnga/ rigs lnga/ rang bzhin dag pa'o/ /'di de hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa thugs kyi dam tshig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ nyid/ / rdo gnyis med ye shes/ rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rdo gnyis med ye shes/ rje snying po'i brtul zhugs brtan/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /oṃ sarba thams cad/ ta thā de bzhin gshegs pa ga ta sid+dhi grub pa'i rdo rje/ badz+ra sa mā dam tshig ya thob/ s+t+waṃ dha ra ye shes kun tu 'gro ba/ ya mi hī hi dri ma drug dag pa'i ye shes drug hi hi hi hūm̐/ kun kyang cho ga dbang bskur ba'i rjes la mchod bstod la sogs pa byed pa gcig pa yis/ /rtag tu bla med gsum gyis/ mchod pas ni/ /slob ma la/ rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin/ / tshigs bcad gong ma brjod pa'i rjes la/ phyis ni rdo rje lag slob dpon gyi nas slob ma'i/ lag / tu gtad/ sems rdo rje sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings dag pa chos kyi sku/ thog ma mtha' ma med/ / de'i ming*/ rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa dag pas/ dga' chen rin 'byung*/ po/ /kun 'od dpag med/ tu bzang po kun don grub/ gyi bdag /rdo rje snyems rnam snang*/ ma'i bdag po'i bdag / yang ni der a las bskyed pa'i/ ni dril bu sbyin

pa gsung gi dam tshig shes rab pha rol phyin a las/ skyes pa'i/ rdo rje dril bu zhes bya ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gang la cis 'dul de la gsung de dang de'i rnam par staun pa/ kyi | | shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /rgyal bas byang chub mchog brjod pa/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ / phyag rgya'i dam tshig kha bskang*/ dbugs 'og nas kyi/ 'byin thams cad byin dang*/ nas mchog tu dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/zhes sogs kyis| ni/ /shākya thub par 'i bstan pa yin pas de'i cha lugs su/ rang lung bstan pa'i phyir/ gyur pas/ /slob ma chen po lung bstan te/ /sangs da lta rgyal ba lnga'i ngo bor byas pas phyis| rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ khyod kyi 'chi ba med/ 'jigs pa dang*/ mya ngan med/ / de bzhin nad dang tsha ba med/ / ces dbugs dbyung*/ bde chen lung bstan/ theg pa chen po ni/ / 'dod yon lnga bsten pa lam du byed pa/ 'di las nga yis lung bstan bu/ / zhes bos nas| oṃ e sho haṃ byā ka ro mi twāṃ badz+ra sātwa ta thā ga ta/ ngas 'dir khyod la lung bstan pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bsgral te/ shin tu srid pa rnam pa dag pa 'i dngos grub phyir/ /kye de phyin chad sa 'og sa steng sa bla na rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par 'grub bo zer/ grub gyur me tog gi phreng ba'i dus su ji skad bya bar btags pa'i| de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /ming ni rdo rje zhes byar 'gyur/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis rig ma chen mo'i dbang gi bskur bar bya ba las mi 'da' bas/ dam tshig bka' g+ṇal to/ / de yan chad mngon rtogs gtso bos cung zad 'brel brtsis la 'di na mar shin tu 'khrugs pas 'brel mi rtsi gsung*/ de nas bcom 'dir rigs sdus phye kun gyi mngon rtogs yan lag drug tu mdor bstan bdun pas byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags dang bcas pa 'byung bcu gnyis par rje btsun ma dang thun mong du sngon 'gro dang bcas nas bstan/

ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po ting nge 'dzin rim pa gnyis kyi/ rdo rje ston pa pos 'og nas kyi rim pa gnyis 'da' bar mi bya bas/ dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba byung ste/ tshig 'di snying kha'i 'od kyis lha dang bla ma spyan drangs te mchod pa dang bdun rnam dag dang bstod pa'o// bka' stsal pa/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha/ rdo rje rnams lha mo brgyad kyis/ mchod cing bstod / /bdun po rnam par dag par bya/ /byang shu n+ya tās stong par byas/ chub sems ni bskyed nas su/ /chos srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ kyi 'byung gnas rnam par bsgom/ /de chos 'byung gi steng du/ la sangs rgyas 'byung ba rim brtsegs/ gnas bsams rnam snang gi ngo bo/ nas/ /rnam dang po mngon par byang chub pa/ pa lnga ni bsgom par bya/ / lha mo dbyung ba'i dang po'i skyes rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bu bsams de nas2 | | mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo spro/ /dri rang gi shes pa 'bru gsum gyis rnam pa ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar na'o// za mnyam par zhugs pa ni/ / dri za nye bar 'khor ba sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge gsum ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du bcug ste rang gi zhal nas zhugs te khong par zhu ba de rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mar babs nas/ khu de'i rjes la yab yum gyi phung por/ bar rjes su dran par bya | | mtshams zhu ba'i 'od las byung ba'i/ kyi lha mos le'u brgyad pa nas 'byung ba/ bskul bar bya/ /'khor lo'i 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang bzhengs pa/ 'dren pa bskul nas byang chub pa lnga las bzhengs nas/ ni/ / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa la/ mig la sogs pa gti mug rdo rje| sogs/ / sku gsung thugs/ rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /phyi nas rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag rdo rje ste/ / rdo rjes rjes su mnyes byed dang zer/ ye shes rnam par dgug pa/ gzhug pa yang*/ /dbang 'khrud/ ni rig ma brgyad rnams kyi/ /yang gsum pa/

ni bdud drug pa/ rtsi myang ba gnyis su/ dang*/ /lha mo brgyad kyis 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang yab yum sbyor ba las de bzhin gshegs pa'i khong par btsud/ rjes su chags pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags brjod do/ /de dag ni dang po'i sbyor ba'o//de nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pa'i byang sems sa bon gyi yi ger gyur pa las 'khor gyi lha mo de dang der spro zhing dgod do/ / mchod pa bzhi pa/ nyid/ / 'khor lo'i lnga pa/ 'dren pa drug pa bstod pa'o/ / kha dog gi sgo nas rigs drug tu byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /yang na bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa des thams cad lhan skyes su rlob gsung*/ rang byin brlab rags pa'i rnal 'byor/ pas byin brlabs te/ /de la 'khor lo bzhi'i rim pas sgom la thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa'i 'phen pas lte ba'i aṃ 'bar te hūm̐ la phog pas hūm̐ las 'od nag po 'phros nas de thams cad nag por byas yang oṃ gyi 'od hūm̐ la phog pas hūm̐ dmar por gyur pa de las 'od 'phros pas de thams cad dmar por ro//gzhan 'dra/yang na lhan skyes kyi bde ba nyid kha dog tu snang gsung*/ yan lag drug bsgom bya/ / ste de ltar bdun rang byin gyis brlab pa rags pa bsgom par ma zad phra mo yang sgom zhes sdud/ gnas skabs kun tu/ phyi nas yang ni 'da' bar mi bya bas/ dam tshig gi/ cho ga'i go rim pa'i rjes la brtags so/ / rim rim pa yis/ / bsgom pa las/ mtshan mtshon par byed pa ste dngos grub gyi rtags/ ma yang dag mtshon dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rang*/ par bya/ / drod la sogs pa mthong lam la thug pa lnga'i gnas skabs la sbyar dang po drod/ sprin gyi rnam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mi gsal bar mthong pa ste/ /gnyis rtse mo pa du ba 'dra nam mkha' la chags pa'i sprin dud dang 'dra/ ba nyid/ /gsum pa bzod pa/ me khyer dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa'i dus su shes pa dmar tshig tshig pa 'byung*/

rnam pa ste//bzhi pa mar chos mchog me nyer 'bar ba// gsal bar snang*/ lnga pa mthong lam/ rtag tu snang yang shin tu gsal ba ste dkyil 'khor mngon sum dang 'dra ba mthong ba ste/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid/ /de rtags/ nyid thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu/ /dngos mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan pa'i sku/ grub nye bar 'gyur ba yin | | phyi bsgom lam tshigs bcad gcig nas rjes thob la/ sgyu ma'i rnam par ltar/ /rmi lam dang sad pa dbyer med pa/ rnam par skad cig rtags de lta bu byung na dngos grub rang 'gyur// phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid rang khams gsum rgyu chos skur grub/ dang mi rgyu gzugs skur grub/ ba'i | | phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub/ ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ / 'khor ba/ 'jig rten mthar phyin pa'i lam tshigs bcad gcig khams ni thams cad du/ /ji srid rdo rje'i sa bcu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ lus can rnams/ /ye shes rdo rje 'dzin pa thob pa phung po'i blo ldan pa/ /de yi rjes mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan pa'i longs sku/ su thams cad 'brang | | ji srid skye gnas sangs rgyas kyi sa dngos/ las bzhi yis bsdus pa thams cad dam/ byung ba/ khams gsum gyis bsdus pa thams cad kyang rdo rje theg pa'i/ lam ni nyams dga' bar | | 'di la gnas pa/ phyag rgya chen po 'i dngos grub la/ rab tu sbyor ba de yi/ sa/ / so so'i skye bo khyad par can de rnams thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med du longs spyad par bya'o// bza' spyad zer/ bar 'khor du 'gyur/ bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ de bzhin gshegs/ / pa rnams/ rim pa gnyis sgom pa dang*/ de'i dngos grub kyi rtags dang*/ dngos grub kyi mtshan nyid gsungs pa'i tshig gi rdo rje rnams thos nas/ /dga' zhing rangs par gyur nas ni/ / yid rang ba'am ngo mtshar ba'i tshig gi smra ba'i rdo rje'i mdzad gsung*/ par ldan/ / rgyas pa/ rig ma chen mo dngos grub sgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gang la brten te bya ba'i lha bstan/

bdag med dang | | rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen dang*// rta mchog thub pa chen po dang*/ /rdo rje nyi ma gzi brjid che/ /rta mgrin mnga' bdag chen po ni/ / bsgom tsam na de dag la/ sku gsung thugs lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis brlab pa/ ni nyid dang yang*/ / de cis kyang dngos grub tu 'gyur bas/ lus kyi gong bu ril po/ 'gul g.yo zhing*/ bar 1 ste 'bras bur/ 2zhes pa ni bton pa ste steng du mkha' spyod pa'i khyad par te/ 'gyur/ / ro//sgrub pa po nyams su len pa'i dus/ lan cig rgyal po ston pa dpral bar sku rdo rje zhar byung*/ mkha 'a spyod bskyed pa'o// yis/ /'phral du mngon sum

snying khar thugs rdo rje sgom pa po med/ byed zhes pa mgrin par gsung rdo rje sa spyod zhar byung*/ bskyed pa'o// pa po/ / nges par 'grub| de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sku gsum mchog mngon rtogs rigs bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs ltar shes par bya/ gi rdo rje 'dzin pa po thams cad/ mnyam par rtogs pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ tshig mi bskyod pa'i rigs bsdus pa'i/ 'di gsungs so | | 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i cha lugs kyis/ ma mo'i dbus na/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na/ la bzhugs pa/ /zhal brgyad pa la bdud bzhi gnon pas/ stobs po che/ /phyag ni bcu drug rnams dang ldan/ /dbang po'i jon po mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /gzi brjid chen po zhabs bzhi pa/ /sgeg sems can gyi don la/ cing khro thugs rjes bcos ma'i/ bo'i gzugs can te/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /dkar po dmar pos rnam par brgyan | | lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa sta | | spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /der ni rdo rje mdog nag po/ /'od zer chen po'ang bsgom par bya/ /dbang bskur ba yi gnas spyi bo/ nyid yang na dpral ba/ du | | sangs rgyas lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ / dag pa'i thod pa lngas kyang yin mod rigs lnga rang bsam/ glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad du ni/ /gnyis 'thung la sogs rim shes bya/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni | | drod dang zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /mthar byed dang ni gnod sbyin nyid/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ /skyes bu 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin/ chen po gzhengs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// // des skye mched dang sku gsum thugs byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ gti mug rdo rje mig la dgod | | zhe sdang rdo rje rna ba la/
