/ser sna 'dod chags de bzhin du/ /rig dang bdag med bsgom par bya/ / kun kyang zer phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa zer/ yin/ / dkar mo la sogs sna tshogs gzugs ma btsun mo lha mo'i cha lugs pa bya/ nyid/ /lag pa gri gug thod pas brel/ /srog son steng du yang dag gnas/ /sa de'i gnas gang du/ cho ga gang gis/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ spyod mkha' spyod ma nyid dang*/ /de bzhin rkang 'og gnas pa mo/ /'di nyid kyi phyag gnyis zhal gcig ma zhes pa la sogs pa/ ni cho ga yis/ /gnas gsum dpral ba la sogs pa/ du ni gnas par bsgom/ /oṃ mdzad mkha' spyod ma rnam snang gi ngo bo/ rgyal po chen po ni/ /sku yi dpral bar/ rdo rje rnam par brgyan/ /thugs hūm̐ las snying khar bskyed pa/ kyi rdo rje rgyal sa 'og po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snying khar/ gnas na bzhugs/ /a ni sa spyod/ mchog gi de nyid de/ / ngag gi mgrin pa/ lam ni gsal byed brjod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ / chos can la ni rigs gsum gyi ngo bo/ 'byung*/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma/ gnas par/ /dkar mo'i gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /lcags kyu sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ kha dog dkar mo'i 'od chen mo/ /dkar mo rdo rje can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dmar mo'i dkyil 'khor nyi ma/ dbus gnas par | | chom rkun ma yi gzugs can bsgom/ /btso ma gser gy-i mdog 'dra ba// rdo rje 'gugs pa'i las byed/ zhags pa mtshon chen mo'o/ / nyi ma bsreg par byed pa las mi phyed pas rdo rje/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ro langs ma ni khrag dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje yis mtshan pa'i/ lcags sgrog thogs pa/ nga rgyal byed/ /byang chub 'ching gzhan du mi gtong ste/ bar mdzad pa mo/ / nyi ma 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par | | de nas ghasma rī bsgom bya/ /rdo rje sa mtshan pa'i/ dril bus lag pa brel/

/ mar rgad sna tshogs kyi ngo bo nyid yin/ ut+pal sngon po 'dra ba'o/ /rdo rje sgo skyong ma rdo rje brtson pa zhes dgug pa dang gzhug pa la sogs pa la/ bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mtshams su lha mo bzhi rnams ni/ /cho ga'i sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /byang chu dag pa/ sems sa wa ri yis gang ba'i thod pa/ bum pa ri rab sa dag pa/ dang*/ / puk+ka sī/ me yi thab me dag pa/ khung tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rgyal rlung dag pa mtshan che/ / g.yung mo/ phyi thabs shes rab gnyis med yin yang bdag med ma phyi ltar snang bcas gnyis med zhal sbyor/ rnal 'byor las/ /mgon pa ོ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin/ de ltar bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas | | dba' rtog pa'i/ rlabs med pa'i bde ba 'thob/ /'byung ba bzhi'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po theg pa gsum nyan rang theg chen gyi nang na rdo rje theg pa/ gyi dam pa gsang sngags/ ston pa po thams cad kyi mngon du mdzad/ rnam pa'i ting nge khro chung*/ 'dzin la bzhugs te/ dbyangs khro bo bcu ston pa'i/ 'di gsungs pa/ hūm̐ tsam rang las/ las byung gshin rje gshed/ ba'i khro bo sku mdog sngon po tho ba thogs pa be ros mtshan pa/ ni | | shar phyogs kyi gshin rje gshed kyis dgug pa'i las bya ba bstan/ rtag tu zhe sdang rtog pa la/ ldan pa'o/ /nang du dgug pa'i bsam pa/ ma rungs rtog pa spong ba'i/ sems kyis ni/ / rtag tu gnyis med kyis tha mal gyi rtog pa bkrus la/ 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ / phyag 'tshal lo| na maḥman+ta sangs rgyas la kun nas dang bas/ bud+dhe bh+yo rdo rje tho ba thogs pa'i lag pa/ na mo badz+ra mud ka ra hasta ya tsaṇ+ḍa gtum po/ maṇ+ḍa dkyil 'khor/ lā smod pa/ k+ṣe pa ka rā khyad du gsod par byed pa/ ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje dang srin po la sogs pa/ de nas 'dir khro bo chen po bshad pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jigs shing 'dar bar gyur nas/

mnga' skyabs tshol/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa sngags kyi che ba/ dran par byed do/ /skyes de'i sgrub pa bstan pa'i pad+ma thod pa/ chag gas zag rdol med | | srubs gcig pa dang srubs gnyis pa/ /2 bsgrub bya yang bzhi po gang rung bsam rig1 spyan sogs rig ma bzhi bri yang bri/ ma bzhi ni rab thod pa bri/ sbyor dgug pa la sogs pa'i las bya'o// bas// rig ma bzhi po rang sangs rgyas kun gyis rab rdul phra rab kyis/ tu dgang*// yang na rkang pa la pa ta la zer ba sa bon la yang mtshon bas rkang rjes ni snying kha'i sa bon no//cho ga ni de las spros pa'i 'gugs pa'i zhags pa thogs pa'i lha'o// rkang dgug par bya ba'i rkang rjes kyi rdul gyis gzugs brnyan byas la thod par bzhag rjes rdul gyi sbyor ba cho ga zer/ yis/ /rkang bu mo 'gug na g.yon brkyang yang na gnyis ka g.yas brkyangs pas mnan cing bsdigs par bya/ / sku gsung thugs brlab pa dang go cha dgod pa sku gsum bskyed pa'i gdan dang sa bon dang mtshan ma las lha/ bsgom pa yis/ /bu mo chen mo dgug par bya/ /gshin rje gshed rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// // shes rab mthar byed dkar po dbyug pa thogs pa mi bskyod pas spyi bor mtshan pa'o/ / na lho phyogs kyi khro bo bgegs 'joms pa/ maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥmahā chen po/ daṇ+ḍa dha ra dbyug pa 'dzin pa| bi bi dha ra sna tshogs/ dha ra su ra lha/ a su ra lha min marda 'joms pa/ na bhū tan+nī 'byung po dang yi dwags la sogs pa rtogs pa'i/ r+m+ma tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa stobs po che bshad pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang de bzhin du gzhan de bzhin gshegs pa/ rnams kyang 'dar bar gyur cing rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de dran de la skyabs tshol/ par byed do/ / sgrub byed/ 'byung po yi dwags sha za nyid/ /mkha' 'gro grul bum zin pa la/ /hūm̐ lag pa gnyis hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsam/

gis dregs byas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje btsir bas bde ba lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis su hūm̐ las rdo rje bsams la dril zhing mnye ba dang hūm̐ las rdo rje 'bar bar bskyed pa'i nyungs dkar gyis brdeg go/ nyid/ / gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma thogs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbur brgyan pa'o/ / na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo hu lu hu mdzod cig pa'o// lu mahā 'dod chags kyi nyes pas ma gos pas/ pad+ma 'chi med a mṛ te ku ru mahā bi stong pa de nyams su blangs ba/ ṣā na dug rnam pa rtog pa/ aḥ skye med/ btsan snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya'i lus la/ dug chen po dgug par bya/ /brgyal ba srog dang dran pa nyams pa sad par byed pa'i/ bslang ba de bzhin no/ /pad+ma'i rta mgrin/ dregs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /na byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje gdengs po thogs pa lus thung zhing gsus pa che ba sbrul brgyad kyis brgyan pa skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa mig dmar zlum pa don grub gyis spyi bor mtshan pa'o/ / maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo badz+ra kro ta ya mahā rdo rje khro bo chen po/ daṃ ṣ+tot+ka mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs pa/ ṭa bhā+ai ra wa ya badz+ra rdo rje/ san+to tshogs hā da r+b+pā dregs pa/ ya a mṛ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ ta kun+ta li hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas khro bo chen po bgegs 'joms rdo rje can bshad pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams yid 'jigs nas/ mi dga' bar gyur to/ /rlung gis rlung gis khyer ba'i shing shun nam shing lo/ bteg pa po dang*/ rkang rjes kyi rdul blangs nas/ bsgrub bya de'i gzugs byas la/ de'i ming yang shing shun la sngags dang spel la/ bzung ste/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i glang sna'i gzugs kyi rkang pa'i 'og tu dgod cing

gzugs de'i steng du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba'i bgegs mthar byed rang la phyag rgya gsungs te/ de'i zhabs kyis mnan no| | hūm̐ las bskyed/ phaṭa ces bya ste/ hūm̐ gis nga rgyal byas nas/ rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ 'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i khro bo'i sngags kyi sbyor bas sangs rgyas rnams kyang skrod par byed na gzhan skrod pa lta ci smos/ do/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //shin tu 'di bsgrub tsam na/ legs par bsgrub pa rdzogs kyi bar du/ gsang ba ni/ /bya ba bskrad pa'i/ 'dir ni rab bskul ba/ /ye she rdo rjes bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa/ bya ba ste/ /nyi ma sngon du bsnyen pa byas pa'i rjes las sbyor dus su/ bdun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /na bden bral du dbyug pa sngon po dbyug pa thogs pa/ maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo oṃ ya ma daṇ+ḍa gshin rje'i dbyug pa/ ya ṇi lā sngon po/ daṇ+ḍā dbyug pa/ ya tu ru rengs pa/ tu ru mdzod cig pa'o| | mu ru mu ru sarba thams cad/ duṣ+tan gdug pa can/ mā ra sod cig gnyis/ ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa | de nas khro bo chen po dbyig pa sngon po skyes bu chen po bshad pas/ sems can thams cad dang sangs rgyas rnams srog la the tshom nyams par dogs pa/ du gyur to | | las sbyor gyi dus su/ brgya phrag brgyad bzlas pa tsam gyis dang shin tu bsgoms pas sbyor ba'i cho gas bskul ba las/ gdug pa thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur ro | | dbyig pas mnan pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /na nub byang du mahā bha la sngon po mdung rtse gsum pa thogs par bsgoms la char dbab/ maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo mahā bha la stobs po che/ ya/ u 'chol ba/ ts+tshuṣ+ma kro dha khro bo/ rā dzā rgyal po/ ya sarbā thams cad/ nā klu brgyad/ gā nāṃ hri da yaṃ snying gzir ba ste char dbab pa'i phyir ro// tā ḍā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

de nas khro bo stobs po che/ gtum po chen po bshad pas dug gi gdong 'jigs shing stobs dang bral ba dang*/ skrag cing 'dar bar gyur te/ stobs po che dran par byed do// rdo rje char dbab pa'i/ stobs kyi spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /na dbang ldan du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri thogs pa/ maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo a mi g.yo ba/ tsa la kā nā tse de la blos lta ba'am zur la lta ba/ ṭ+ṭa tseṭ+ṭa mo ṭ+ṭa khol po thams cad 'gug pa/ mo nyes/ ṭ+ṭa tu ṭ+ṭa tuṭ+ṭa ri bo la sogs pa/ chod/ gha gha rgyob rgyob/ gha ta ya gha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba skyes bu chen po bshad pas/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin chen po brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /'dis ni khro bo'i rgyal po yis/ /seng ge saṃ las dgugs par bya ba ste/ zhon bsam pa/ pa'i cho ga yis/ / rlung gi thog tu bzhag rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rlung gi bskyod nas 'ong bar bsgoms pas/ rnal 'byor las/ /skyes pa dang ni lha rnams khugs/ /oṃ gnod mdzes sum+bhā ni sum+bhā ni hūm̐/ gh+ri h+na gh+ri h+na gnod mdzes nges par zung*| hūm̐ gh+ri h+na pa 'khor dang bcas pa zung shig ya gh+ri h+na pa ya hūm̐ a na ya ho kye/ bha ga bcom ldan 'das/ wān bid+ya rā rig pa'i rgyal po/ dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje sa 'og gnas pa yi/ khro bo chen po bshad pa yis/ /lha min bu mo klu mor bcas/ /nu ma 'dar zhing nar ba ma | | rdo rje zhags pas nges bcings te/ /lcags kyu yis ni dral nas ni/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pa yis/ /bu mo thams cad dgug par bya/ /'jig rten gsum dgug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //rdo rje rang nyid rigs lnga'i rnal 'byor la gnas te gnod mdzes la bka' bsgo bas bu mo 'gugs pa/ chos ni char 'od dpag med/ sprin che/ / char 'bebs/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ sems dpa' char mchog ste/

/rdo rje rin 'byung*/ nyi ma dge 'dun yon tan thams cad 'dus/ che/ / rta mchog don grub/ tshogs ni chen po las kyi bdag nyid yin pas/ dang*/ /phan pa'i rnam snang*| yang ni char sprin nga rgyal gyis/ gyis/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i thogs pa'i gnod mdzes 'gugs par/ bsgom pa yis/ / de'i bka' bsgo byas pas sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'gugs par| brjod na/ /sayi steng ga ིskye bo smos ci dgos/ /rang rigs lnga/ gi rig ma gnod mdzes yab yum/ skyes bu bsam/ /sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa/ rdo rjes rnam par brgyan | | snying kha'i hūm̐ las gnod mdzes/ lcags kyu thogs pa spros te/ la sogs sbyor ba yis | | bu mo bkug la de nas snyoms par zhugs pas lhan skyes/ bza' bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje chen pos bkug pa'i dam tshig bka' stsal to//
